Load referenced resources only as needed.\n\n\n\n# DeepSeek Harness documentation\n\nAnswer questions about DSH from the documentation and source of the installed version, not from memory, and extend DSH through bundles installed in the current profile.\n\nLoading this skill does not authorize changes. Write bundle files, run mutating `plugin_manager` actions such as installing, enabling, disabling, or removing, or change a preset only when the user asks to change DSH or its profile. For a question, design, or review, read-only lookups, including `list_plugins` and `list_bundles` within your tool permissions, remain available; report findings and leave files and the profile unchanged. A request for an image, widget, or decoration that does not target DSH, such as its Web UI or profile, is not a request for a DSH plugin; deliver the ordinary artifact the task asks for.\n\n## Find facts in this order\n\n1. Runtime inspection, when `cordis_inspect_list` and `cordis_inspect_query` are among your tools: exact Service methods and Event modes, a mounted plugin's Config schema and `packageDir`, the Tools this Agent can call, and live Client Slots and theme tokens.\n2. The installed documentation and package sources, located as `references/locate-docs.md` describes.\n3. When an answer depends on a live API that you can neither inspect nor read, state what remains unverified. Do not change a preset or the profile to gain tools.\n\n## Read next\n\nThe files below live in this skill's base directory, which the `skill` tool reported, and the table is the complete list: do not enumerate that directory. Read them with the file-read tool, write copies into the workspace with the file-write tool, and verify a copy by reading it back. In Desktop the directory sits inside `app.asar`, which the file-read tool and the runtime that `references/locate-docs.md` describes can open; native utilities such as `ls`, `cat`, `cp`, and `cmp`, the glob and search tools, a `node` from `PATH`, and pnpm fail on it. Never install or syntax-check a template in place; copy its contents into the workspace first.\n\n| Task | File |\n|---|---|\n| Find the installed version's documentation and package sources | registerBoundCredentialRoutes(ctx, logger, appId, { ...config });\n58: const resolvedConfig = { ...config, appId, appSecret };\n59: await bootstrapGateway(ctx, agents, resolvedConfig, logger);\n60: Print only the needed variables: in bash, `printf '%s\\n' \"$DSH_PROFILE\" \"$DSH_INSTALL_DIR\" \"$DSH_NODE_EXECUTABLE\"`; in PowerShell, `$env:DSH_PROFILE; $env:DSH_INSTALL_DIR; $env:DSH_NODE_EXECUTABLE`. Keep the loaded skill's reported Base directory. `DSH_PROFILE=desktop` identifies the Desktop profile, including development launches; `web` can run from npm or source. Profile and distribution are not one-to-one: verify ASAR or checkout markers below. `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` holds the user's profile and added plugins, not the DSH installation root. Standard and Creator are agent modes, not installation layouts.\n8: \n9: Verify that `DSH_INSTALL_DIR/package.json` names `@deepseek-ai/dsh`; its `version` identifies the running CLI package. Resolve symlinks before comparing directories. Missing variables alone do not establish that there is no profile or no source. Use the loaded skill's location or an inspected package directory to verify a candidate; if none is verifiable, report what remains unlocated. Do not change the profile to obtain tools.\n10: \n11: ## Source checkout\n12: \n13: A source launch normally points `DSH_INSTALL_DIR` at `/apps/cli`. Verify `/pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `/package.json` with name `@deepseek-ai/dsh-root`, and `/apps/cli/package.json` with name `@deepseek-ai/dsh`. The loaded skill may instead locate the candidate root: its real directory is `/packages/preset/agent-preset/skills/dsh-doc`, five parents below the root. Verify the same markers; a matching working-directory name is not evidence of the running installation.\n14: \n15: Read `/docs/user/index.md` for user documentation and `/docs/upgrade-guide/` for migration guides. The checkout's `apps/cli/docs` need not exist. Use `/packages/README.md` to find the owning group, then `/packages///package.json` to verify the package name. Read that package's `README.md` and the owning file under `src/`; do not assume every package resolves from `apps/cli/node_modules`. Use the verified CLI manifest's version and identify the checkout used.\n16: \n17: ## npm installation\n18: \n19: For an installed package layout outside an ASAR, verify the CLI manifest at `DSH_INSTALL_DIR` and its packaged `docs/`; do not infer npm installation merely because checkout markers are absent. Read `DSH_INSTALL_DIR/docs/user/index.md` and `DSH_INSTALL_DIR/docs/upgrade-guide/README.md`, the generated index for this installed version's guides.\n20: \n21: Resolve a shipped package's exported `package.json` from this installation anchor with the runtime command below. Read its `README.md`, then the owning file under `src/` when present; `lib/` contains built code. A configuration-only bundle may instead expose its patch files. Do not resolve from the shell's cwd or assume a global npm prefix. A package unavailable from this anchor may be a user-added plugin: use Inspect's package directory when available rather than guessing another installation's files.\n22: \n23: ## Desktop\n24: \n25: For the packaged Desktop app, confirm that the installation or loaded skill path lies inside `app.asar` and the indicated runtime reports `process.versions.electron`. A Desktop development launch with verified checkout markers uses the source route above. Inside the archive, `DSH_INSTALL_DIR` still names the CLI package directory. Read its manifest, `docs/user/index.md`, and `docs/upgrade-guide/README.md` through the Host file-read tool. Resolve other packages from the same anchor and read their README and `src/` through that tool.\n26: \n27: Native grep/glob, `ls`, `cat`, and a Node executable chosen from `PATH` cannot traverse ASAR files. Do not unpack the app to answer a question. For directory listing or bounded search, use `DSH_NODE_EXECUTABLE`, the running Electron executable, with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` as below. It supplies ASAR-aware filesystem reads; an ordinary Node runtime ignores that environment setting.\n28: \n29: ## Resolve a package with the running runtime\n30: \n31: With Inspect available, `Config.listConfigs` filtered by `name` lists mounted entries; querying an `entry` supplies `packageDir`. Otherwise use the installation anchor and executable verified above. Windows Desktop's Electron is a GUI-subsystem executable, for which `&` does not reliably wait. For a custom or single-executable layout, report only locations and versions actually verified.\n63: \n64: ## Bounded lookup\n65: \n66: Read one file at a time. Harness\\resources\\app.asar\\dsh\\node_modules\\@deepseek-ai\\dsh\\docs\\subsystems\\sandbox.zh.md\nfile\n\n1: # 进程沙箱\n2: \n3: [English](sandbox.md) | 中文\n4: \n5: [dsh-sandbox](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox) 的进程沙箱 seam 将与配套子进程提供方共享执行环境的子进程 argv 包装在文件效果策略中，而不将消费方耦合到特定平台运行器。[dsh-sandbox-local](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-local) 提供 Linux bwrap/Landlock、macOS Seatbelt 与 Windows ACL 受限令牌后端；[dsh-bash-sandbox](../../packages/shell/bash-sandbox) 和 [dsh-pwsh-sandbox](../../packages/shell/pwsh-sandbox) 是其消费方。[dsh-sandbox-ssh](../../packages/ssh/sandbox-ssh/README.zh.md) 通过与 SSH 文件系统及子进程提供方配套的远端后端执行同一策略。\n6: \n7: 源码：[`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts`](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts)\n8: \n9: ## 模式与强制执行\n10: \n11: `SandboxMode` 仅管控文件系统效果。`read-only` 要求后端拒绝写入——POSIX runner 还会授予其 shell 所需的 `/dev/null` 接收器，而 Windows ACL runner 不授予任何显式可写根目录，并因环境 ACL 缺口报告部分强制执行；`workspace-write` 允许在工作区根目录、受支持的额外目录及后端承诺的临时区域下写入；`danger-full-access` 绕过隔离。Windows 子进程忽略额外目录授权；Harness 文件工具独立执行这些授权。网络与进程可见性不在此处的定义范围内。\n12: \n13: ```ts type-equiv\n14: /**\n15: * File-effect policy for confined processes. `read-only` permits only required\n16: * sinks such as `/dev/null`; `workspace-write` also permits the workspace,\n17: * explicit extra roots where supported, and backend-defined temp areas; `danger-full-access` bypasses confinement. Network\n18: * and process visibility are outside this vocabulary.\n19: */\n20: type SandboxMode = 'read-only' | 'workspace-write' | 'danger-full-access'\n21: ```\n22: \n23: 只有前两种模式可以发送给提供方。`danger-full-access` 的消费方直接 spawn 原始 argv，不调用 `ctx.sandbox`。\n24: \n25: ```ts type-equiv\n26: /** A confining (non-`danger-full-access`) mode — the modes a {@link SandboxPolicy} can carry. */\n27: type ConfinedSandboxMode = Exclude\n28: ```\n29: \n30: 强制执行完整性是后端报告的事实。`full` 表示后端管控了该模式承诺的所有文件效果；`partial` 表示活跃后端或较旧的内核 ABI 仅管控其中一个子集，因此要求绝对保证的消费方必须拒绝或向上暴露这一区别。当前的部分强制执行情形包括较旧的 Landlock ABI，以及 Windows ACL runner 的硬链接、读取不受限与 AppContainer ACL 边界。\n31: \n32: ```ts type-equiv\n33: /**\n34: * Enforcement completeness for this host. `partial` means an active backend or\n35: * older kernel ABI cannot govern every promised file effect; callers requiring\n36: * an absolute boundary must not treat it as `full`.\n37: */\n38: type SandboxEnforcement = 'full' | 'partial'\n39: ```\n40: \n41: ## 逐调用策略\n42: \n43: 完整执行策略会按每次能力调用解析并携带。它包括 `danger-full-access`，因此消费方可以只解析一次策略，再决定是否绕过约束。普通工具调用从调用会话的不可变 cwd 派生 `workspaceRoot`；部署配置提供无 agent 调用的回退值和共享的额外写入授权。存活 Session 的注册为后续解析添加 effect 生命周期内的目录授权。解析器保留执行环境中的绝对路径写法。执行限制的提供方在文件实际存在的位置规范化根目录，因此包含 `symlink/..` 的 cwd 会标识配套子进程提供方实际运行的目录。\n44: \n45: ```ts type-equiv\n46: /**\n47: * The complete file-effect policy resolved for one capability call. The root\n48: * is carried even under modes that do not consume it so callers can resolve\n49: * policy once before choosing the enforcement path.\n50: */\n51: interface SandboxExecutionPolicy {\n52: /** The file-effect mode this execution runs under. */\n53: mode: SandboxMode\n54: /** Absolute root directory `workspace-write` may write under. */\n55: workspaceRoot: string\n56: /**\n57: * Extra physical absolute directories `workspace-write` may also write under.\n58: * Absence means none. The enforcing host rejects missing, non-directory, and\n59: * symlinked entries on each call. Remote paths are checked on the remote host.\n60: * Windows process confinement ignores these; harness filesystem operations honor them.\n61: * These grant nothing under `read-only` or `danger-full-access`.\n62: */\n63: additionalWritableRoots?: readonly string[]\n64: /**\n65: * Opaque identity of the calling session (the branded `dsh-session`\n66: * SessionId). Backends key per-session state off it (e.g. windows-acl gives\n67: * each live session/workspace pair a random private temp directory and SID,\n68: * while the workspace SID and standing grant remain per-workspace); absent\n69: * for agentless calls, which fall back to per-call backend state.\n70: */\n71: sessionId?: SessionId\n72: }\n73: ```\n74: \n75: `ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve()` 接收活跃会话；对于已批准的重试，还接收显式模式。该服务拥有优先级与 root 回退规则，使 bash 和 fs 不必重复实现。\n76: \n77: ```ts type-equiv\n78: /** Inputs that select the sandbox policy for one capability call. */\n79: interface SandboxPolicyRequest {\n80: /** Calling session; its immutable cwd becomes the workspace boundary. */\n81: session?: Session\n82: /** Explicit approved mode override, which outranks session policy. */\n83: mode?: SandboxMode\n84: }\n85: ```\n86: \n87: 只有受约束的执行会到达 `ctx.sandbox`；传给提供方的策略在保留同一 root 的同时收窄模式。这使并发会话、消费方与一次性提权重试可以向同一提供方请求不同边界，而无需改变提供方状态。\n88: \n89: ```ts type-equiv\n90: /**\n91: * What one confined execution is allowed to touch — carried PER CALL, not\n92: * fixed on the provider: two consumers may confine under different policies\n93: * at the same instant (bash under `read-only` while a confined child agent\n94: * needs its state directory writable), and an approved escalated retry is a\n95: * new call with a wider policy. Defaulting/resolution is an explicit step at\n96: * the consumer boundary; the provider treats the policy as fully specified.\n97: */\n98: interface SandboxPolicy extends SandboxExecutionPolicy {\n99: /** The file-effect mode this execution runs under. */\n100: mode: ConfinedSandboxMode\n101: }\n102: ```\n103: \n104: \n105: \n106: ## 包装后的 argv 与分类方言\n107: \n108: `RunnerFailureRule` 汇集用于判定 runner 在执行命令前失败的证据。消费方要求进程以非零状态退出，并同时满足可选的允许退出码门控，以及余下某一 stderr 行中不区分大小写的致命签名。系统会先按不区分大小写的整行精确匹配移除信息性排除项，因此无害的 runner 通知本身不能证明失败。匹配到的行仍可用作错误详情；分类过程不会重写 stderr。\n109: \n110: ```ts type-equiv\n111: /**\n112: * Evidence that identifies a sandbox runner failing before it executes the\n113: * wrapped command. A consumer first applies {@link allowedExitCodes} when\n114: * present, removes {@link informationalLines} by case-insensitive exact line\n115: * equality, then matches {@link fatalSignatures} case-insensitively within\n116: * each remaining stderr line. Exit status alone never proves runner failure.\n117: */\n118: interface RunnerFailureRule {\n119: /** Nonzero process exit codes on which this rule may match; omitted permits any nonzero exit. */\n120: allowedExitCodes?: readonly number[]\n121: /** Non-empty substrings identifying a fatal runner diagnostic on one stderr line. */\n122: fatalSignatures: readonly string[]\n123: /** Benign stderr lines excluded by exact full-line equality before fatal matching. */\n124: informationalLines?: readonly string[]\n125: }\n126: ```\n127: \n128: `ConfinedArgv` 是消费方实际 spawn 的内容。除了替换后的 argv，它还携带后端的强制执行事实和两种正交的 stderr 分类器。`denialSignatures` 用于识别沙箱正常工作时受限命令被阻止的情况。`runnerFailureRules` 用于识别沙箱 runner 在执行命令之前拒绝或失败的情况；消费方应先检查后者，将其作为沙箱基础设施故障上报，而非普通任务失败。\n129: \n130: ```ts type-equiv\n131: /**\n132: * A {@link SandboxProvider.confine} result: the argv to spawn in place of\n133: * the caller's own, plus the enforcement completeness the selected backend\n134: * achieves for it.\n135: */\n136: interface ConfinedArgv {\n137: /** The wrapped argv (runner, profile, separator, then the caller's argv). */\n138: argv: string[]\n139: /** How completely the selected backend enforces the policy's file effects. */\n140: enforcement: SandboxEnforcement\n141: /**\n142: * The selected backend's denial DIALECT: the case-insensitive stderr\n143: * substrings a file effect denied by THIS backend produces (EROFS text\n144: * under bwrap's read-only binds, EACCES under Landlock, EPERM under\n145: * Seatbelt). A consumer that infers denials from a failed run's stderr\n146: * matches against exactly these rather than a cross-backend union — the\n147: * union claims denials a given backend never produces.\n148: */\n149: denialSignatures: readonly string[]\n150: /**\n151: * Structured runner-failure evidence rules. Consumers require a matching\n152: * fatal stderr line (after informational exclusions) and any rule-specific\n153: * exit-code gate before checking denial signatures: runner failure means the\n154: * command never ran, while denial means confinement worked and blocked it.\n155: */\n156: runnerFailureRules: readonly RunnerFailureRule[]\n157: }\n158: ```\n159: \n160: [本地提供方](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/README.zh.md)拥有运维配置，并将其 runner 方言映射到这些规则。[沙箱化 bash 消费方](../../packages/shell/bash-sandbox/README.zh.md)拥有 spawn 与结果归因。\n161: \n162: ## 提供方与 fail-closed 错误\n163: \n164: `await ctx.sandbox.confine(argv, policy, signal)` 在执行环境中解析策略路径并返回 `ConfinedArgv`，没有可用后端时以 `SandboxUnavailableError`（错误码 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`）拒绝，提供方无法为该模式准备主机状态时以 `SandboxPreparationError`（`SANDBOX_PREPARATION_FAILED`、`SANDBOX_INVALID_TEMP_ROOT`）拒绝。可选信号可在启动前取消解析。消费方也可以在 spawn 或观察所返回的 argv 时对失败进行分类；该归因属于消费方约定。对于受限策略，静默的无隔离透传永远不合法。\n165: \n166: 提供方选择、探测、缓存和后端特定的强制执行报告归[本地提供方](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/README.zh.md)所有。\n167: \n168: \n169: \n170: \n171: \n172: ## Cordis API\n173: \n174: Generated from source by `scripts/gen-cordis-catalog.ts` (verified fresh by `pnpm run verify-cordis-catalog` in doc-sync; regenerate with `pnpm run gen-cordis-catalog`) — the language sides differ only in locale-specific paired document paths. Signature blocks use a `ts cordis-catalog` fence and keep the original source JSDoc; dispatch modes are defined in the [primer](../cordis-primer.zh.md#dispatch-modes), and the framework-inherited `ctx` API lives in [cordis-api/inherited.md](../cordis-api/inherited.md).\n175: \n176: \n177: \n178: ### `ctx.sandbox` — `SandboxProvider` (abstract seam)\n179: \n180: Abstract process-sandbox service. confine must return enforcing argv or fail closed at wrap or runner-execution time; silent unconfined passthrough is forbidden. Functional probes arbitrate multi-runner chains and may be skipped for a sole candidate, whose own refusal remains the fail-closed end.\n181: \n182: ```ts cordis-catalog\n183: /**\n184: * Wrap `argv` so it executes confined under `policy` on this host; the\n185: * caller spawns the returned argv in place of its own.\n186: * @param argv - the exact argv the caller is about to spawn (program plus\n187: * arguments), NOT a shell string — a shell-shaped consumer passes\n188: * `['bash', '-c', command]`.\n189: * @param policy - the file-effect policy this execution runs under,\n190: * carried per call (see {@link SandboxPolicy}).\n191: * @param signal - cancellation while the provider resolves the policy and runner.\n192: * @returns the argv to spawn instead, plus the enforcement completeness\n193: * the selected backend achieves for it.\n194: */\n195: abstract confine(argv: readonly string[], policy: SandboxPolicy, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise\n196: ```\n197: \n198: Source: [`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts`](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts)\n199: \n200: \n201: \n202: ### `ctx.sandboxPolicy` — `SandboxPolicyService`\n203: \n204: The sandbox-policy service (`ctx.sandboxPolicy`). Owns the deployment default mode, fallback workspace root, session-scoped directory grants, and request-time policy section. Tool layers call resolve for each execution so a session's mode log and immutable cwd travel together to every enforcing capability.\n205: \n206: ```ts cordis-catalog\n207: /**\n208: * Resolve the complete policy for one capability call. An approved explicit\n209: * mode outranks the session's last `sandbox/mode` event, which outranks the\n210: * deployment default. A session cwd is its workspace-write boundary; the\n211: * configured root is the fallback for agentless calls and sessions without a\n212: * cwd. Configured extra roots and this Session's active registrations are\n213: * snapshotted together; existing operations and processes keep their policy.\n214: * @param request - optional session and approved mode override.\n215: * @returns the fully resolved per-call mode and absolute workspace root.\n216: * @throws `SandboxInvalidRootError` (`SANDBOX_INVALID_ROOT`) when the session's recorded cwd is\n217: * relative or contains a NUL byte.\n218: */\n219: resolve(request: SandboxPolicyRequest = {}): SandboxExecutionPolicy\n220: \n221: /**\n222: * Permit writes under one directory in this Session's future workspace-write\n223: * operations. The calling context owns the effect; disposal removes only this\n224: * registration. Other grants to the directory remain effective. Existing\n225: * operations and persistent processes retain their resolved permissions.\n226: * Grants are runtime-only and must be registered again after resume or fork.\n227: * On Windows, only harness file tools honor extra grants; process permissions stay unchanged.\n228: * @param session - exact live Session receiving the grant; other Sessions and agentless calls are unaffected.\n229: * @param directory - absolute execution-world path; execution rejects missing, non-directory, or symlinked paths.\n230: * @returns the exact Cordis effect disposer for this registration.\n231: * @throws when the directory is relative or contains a NUL byte.\n232: */\n233: registerWritableRoot(session: Session, directory: string): () => void\n234: \n235: /**\n236: * Read the session override without applying the deployment default.\n237: * @param session - session whose log supplies the override.\n238: * @returns the last logged mode, or `undefined` without one.\n239: */\n240: overrideOf(session: Session): SandboxMode | undefined\n241: ```\n242: \n243: Types: [Session](session.zh.md)\n244: \n245: Source: [`packages/sandbox/sandbox-policy/src/index.ts`](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-policy/src/index.ts)\n246: \n\n(End of file - total 246 lines)\n"}],"isError":false,"id":"cd3cebee-52cd-4e48-be9b-8703536a332a"},"meta":{"path":"C:\\Users\\xueha\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\DeepSeek Harness\\resources\\app.asar\\dsh\\node_modules\\@deepseek-ai\\dsh\\docs\\subsystems\\sandbox.zh.md","offset":1,"lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# 进程沙箱"},{"number":2,"text":""},{"number":3,"text":"[English](sandbox.md) | 中文"},{"number":4,"text":""},{"number":5,"text":"[dsh-sandbox](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox) 的进程沙箱 seam 将与配套子进程提供方共享执行环境的子进程 argv 包装在文件效果策略中，而不将消费方耦合到特定平台运行器。[dsh-sandbox-local](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-local) 提供 Linux bwrap/Landlock、macOS Seatbelt 与 Windows ACL 受限令牌后端；[dsh-bash-sandbox](../../packages/shell/bash-sandbox) 和 [dsh-pwsh-sandbox](../../packages/shell/pwsh-sandbox) 是其消费方。[dsh-sandbox-ssh](../../packages/ssh/sandbox-ssh/README.zh.md) 通过与 SSH 文件系统及子进程提供方配套的远端后端执行同一策略。"},{"number":6,"text":""},{"number":7,"text":"源码：[`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts`](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts)"},{"number":8,"text":""},{"number":9,"text":"## 模式与强制执行"},{"number":10,"text":""},{"number":11,"text":"`SandboxMode` 仅管控文件系统效果。`read-only` 要求后端拒绝写入——POSIX runner 还会授予其 shell 所需的 `/dev/null` 接收器，而 Windows ACL runner 不授予任何显式可写根目录，并因环境 ACL 缺口报告部分强制执行；`workspace-write` 允许在工作区根目录、受支持的额外目录及后端承诺的临时区域下写入；`danger-full-access` 绕过隔离。Windows 子进程忽略额外目录授权；Harness 文件工具独立执行这些授权。网络与进程可见性不在此处的定义范围内。"},{"number":12,"text":""},{"number":13,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":14,"text":"/**"},{"number":15,"text":" * File-effect policy for confined processes. `read-only` permits only required"},{"number":16,"text":" * sinks such as `/dev/null`; `workspace-write` also permits the workspace,"},{"number":17,"text":" * explicit extra roots where supported, and backend-defined temp areas; `danger-full-access` bypasses confinement. Network"},{"number":18,"text":" * and process visibility are outside this vocabulary."},{"number":19,"text":" */"},{"number":20,"text":"type SandboxMode = 'read-only' | 'workspace-write' | 'danger-full-access'"},{"number":21,"text":"```"},{"number":22,"text":""},{"number":23,"text":"只有前两种模式可以发送给提供方。`danger-full-access` 的消费方直接 spawn 原始 argv，不调用 `ctx.sandbox`。"},{"number":24,"text":""},{"number":25,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":26,"text":"/** A confining (non-`danger-full-access`) mode — the modes a {@link SandboxPolicy} can carry. */"},{"number":27,"text":"type ConfinedSandboxMode = Exclude"},{"number":28,"text":"```"},{"number":29,"text":""},{"number":30,"text":"强制执行完整性是后端报告的事实。`full` 表示后端管控了该模式承诺的所有文件效果；`partial` 表示活跃后端或较旧的内核 ABI 仅管控其中一个子集，因此要求绝对保证的消费方必须拒绝或向上暴露这一区别。当前的部分强制执行情形包括较旧的 Landlock ABI，以及 Windows ACL runner 的硬链接、读取不受限与 AppContainer ACL 边界。"},{"number":31,"text":""},{"number":32,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":33,"text":"/**"},{"number":34,"text":" * Enforcement completeness for this host. `partial` means an active backend or"},{"number":35,"text":" * older kernel ABI cannot govern every promised file effect; callers requiring"},{"number":36,"text":" * an absolute boundary must not treat it as `full`."},{"number":37,"text":" */"},{"number":38,"text":"type SandboxEnforcement = 'full' | 'partial'"},{"number":39,"text":"```"},{"number":40,"text":""},{"number":41,"text":"## 逐调用策略"},{"number":42,"text":""},{"number":43,"text":"完整执行策略会按每次能力调用解析并携带。它包括 `danger-full-access`，因此消费方可以只解析一次策略，再决定是否绕过约束。普通工具调用从调用会话的不可变 cwd 派生 `workspaceRoot`；部署配置提供无 agent 调用的回退值和共享的额外写入授权。存活 Session 的注册为后续解析添加 effect 生命周期内的目录授权。解析器保留执行环境中的绝对路径写法。执行限制的提供方在文件实际存在的位置规范化根目录，因此包含 `symlink/..` 的 cwd 会标识配套子进程提供方实际运行的目录。"},{"number":44,"text":""},{"number":45,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":46,"text":"/**"},{"number":47,"text":" * The complete file-effect policy resolved for one capability call. The root"},{"number":48,"text":" * is carried even under modes that do not consume it so callers can resolve"},{"number":49,"text":" * policy once before choosing the enforcement path."},{"number":50,"text":" */"},{"number":51,"text":"interface SandboxExecutionPolicy {"},{"number":52,"text":" /** The file-effect mode this execution runs under. */"},{"number":53,"text":" mode: SandboxMode"},{"number":54,"text":" /** Absolute root directory `workspace-write` may write under. */"},{"number":55,"text":" workspaceRoot: string"},{"number":56,"text":" /**"},{"number":57,"text":" * Extra physical absolute directories `workspace-write` may also write under."},{"number":58,"text":" * Absence means none. The enforcing host rejects missing, non-directory, and"},{"number":59,"text":" * symlinked entries on each call. Remote paths are checked on the remote host."},{"number":60,"text":" * Windows process confinement ignores these; harness filesystem operations honor them."},{"number":61,"text":" * These grant nothing under `read-only` or `danger-full-access`."},{"number":62,"text":" */"},{"number":63,"text":" additionalWritableRoots?: readonly string[]"},{"number":64,"text":" /**"},{"number":65,"text":" * Opaque identity of the calling session (the branded `dsh-session`"},{"number":66,"text":" * SessionId). Backends key per-session state off it (e.g. windows-acl gives"},{"number":67,"text":" * each live session/workspace pair a random private temp directory and SID,"},{"number":68,"text":" * while the workspace SID and standing grant remain per-workspace); absent"},{"number":69,"text":" * for agentless calls, which fall back to per-call backend state."},{"number":70,"text":" */"},{"number":71,"text":" sessionId?: SessionId"},{"number":72,"text":"}"},{"number":73,"text":"```"},{"number":74,"text":""},{"number":75,"text":"`ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve()` 接收活跃会话；对于已批准的重试，还接收显式模式。该服务拥有优先级与 root 回退规则，使 bash 和 fs 不必重复实现。"},{"number":76,"text":""},{"number":77,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":78,"text":"/** Inputs that select the sandbox policy for one capability call. */"},{"number":79,"text":"interface SandboxPolicyRequest {"},{"number":80,"text":" /** Calling session; its immutable cwd becomes the workspace boundary. */"},{"number":81,"text":" session?: Session"},{"number":82,"text":" /** Explicit approved mode override, which outranks session policy. */"},{"number":83,"text":" mode?: SandboxMode"},{"number":84,"text":"}"},{"number":85,"text":"```"},{"number":86,"text":""},{"number":87,"text":"只有受约束的执行会到达 `ctx.sandbox`；传给提供方的策略在保留同一 root 的同时收窄模式。这使并发会话、消费方与一次性提权重试可以向同一提供方请求不同边界，而无需改变提供方状态。"},{"number":88,"text":""},{"number":89,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":90,"text":"/**"},{"number":91,"text":" * What one confined execution is allowed to touch — carried PER CALL, not"},{"number":92,"text":" * fixed on the provider: two consumers may confine under different policies"},{"number":93,"text":" * at the same instant (bash under `read-only` while a confined child agent"},{"number":94,"text":" * needs its state directory writable), and an approved escalated retry is a"},{"number":95,"text":" * new call with a wider policy. Defaulting/resolution is an explicit step at"},{"number":96,"text":" * the consumer boundary; the provider treats the policy as fully specified."},{"number":97,"text":" */"},{"number":98,"text":"interface SandboxPolicy extends SandboxExecutionPolicy {"},{"number":99,"text":" /** The file-effect mode this execution runs under. */"},{"number":100,"text":" mode: ConfinedSandboxMode"},{"number":101,"text":"}"},{"number":102,"text":"```"},{"number":103,"text":""},{"number":104,"text":""},{"number":105,"text":""},{"number":106,"text":"## 包装后的 argv 与分类方言"},{"number":107,"text":""},{"number":108,"text":"`RunnerFailureRule` 汇集用于判定 runner 在执行命令前失败的证据。消费方要求进程以非零状态退出，并同时满足可选的允许退出码门控，以及余下某一 stderr 行中不区分大小写的致命签名。系统会先按不区分大小写的整行精确匹配移除信息性排除项，因此无害的 runner 通知本身不能证明失败。匹配到的行仍可用作错误详情；分类过程不会重写 stderr。"},{"number":109,"text":""},{"number":110,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":111,"text":"/**"},{"number":112,"text":" * Evidence that identifies a sandbox runner failing before it executes the"},{"number":113,"text":" * wrapped command. A consumer first applies {@link allowedExitCodes} when"},{"number":114,"text":" * present, removes {@link informationalLines} by case-insensitive exact line"},{"number":115,"text":" * equality, then matches {@link fatalSignatures} case-insensitively within"},{"number":116,"text":" * each remaining stderr line. Exit status alone never proves runner failure."},{"number":117,"text":" */"},{"number":118,"text":"interface RunnerFailureRule {"},{"number":119,"text":" /** Nonzero process exit codes on which this rule may match; omitted permits any nonzero exit. */"},{"number":120,"text":" allowedExitCodes?: readonly number[]"},{"number":121,"text":" /** Non-empty substrings identifying a fatal runner diagnostic on one stderr line. */"},{"number":122,"text":" fatalSignatures: readonly string[]"},{"number":123,"text":" /** Benign stderr lines excluded by exact full-line equality before fatal matching. */"},{"number":124,"text":" informationalLines?: readonly string[]"},{"number":125,"text":"}"},{"number":126,"text":"```"},{"number":127,"text":""},{"number":128,"text":"`ConfinedArgv` 是消费方实际 spawn 的内容。除了替换后的 argv，它还携带后端的强制执行事实和两种正交的 stderr 分类器。`denialSignatures` 用于识别沙箱正常工作时受限命令被阻止的情况。`runnerFailureRules` 用于识别沙箱 runner 在执行命令之前拒绝或失败的情况；消费方应先检查后者，将其作为沙箱基础设施故障上报，而非普通任务失败。"},{"number":129,"text":""},{"number":130,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":131,"text":"/**"},{"number":132,"text":" * A {@link SandboxProvider.confine} result: the argv to spawn in place of"},{"number":133,"text":" * the caller's own, plus the enforcement completeness the selected backend"},{"number":134,"text":" * achieves for it."},{"number":135,"text":" */"},{"number":136,"text":"interface ConfinedArgv {"},{"number":137,"text":" /** The wrapped argv (runner, profile, separator, then the caller's argv). */"},{"number":138,"text":" argv: string[]"},{"number":139,"text":" /** How completely the selected backend enforces the policy's file effects. */"},{"number":140,"text":" enforcement: SandboxEnforcement"},{"number":141,"text":" /**"},{"number":142,"text":" * The selected backend's denial DIALECT: the case-insensitive stderr"},{"number":143,"text":" * substrings a file effect denied by THIS backend produces (EROFS text"},{"number":144,"text":" * under bwrap's read-only binds, EACCES under Landlock, EPERM under"},{"number":145,"text":" * Seatbelt). A consumer that infers denials from a failed run's stderr"},{"number":146,"text":" * matches against exactly these rather than a cross-backend union — the"},{"number":147,"text":" * union claims denials a given backend never produces."},{"number":148,"text":" */"},{"number":149,"text":" denialSignatures: readonly string[]"},{"number":150,"text":" /**"},{"number":151,"text":" * Structured runner-failure evidence rules. Consumers require a matching"},{"number":152,"text":" * fatal stderr line (after informational exclusions) and any rule-specific"},{"number":153,"text":" * exit-code gate before checking denial signatures: runner failure means the"},{"number":154,"text":" * command never ran, while denial means confinement worked and blocked it."},{"number":155,"text":" */"},{"number":156,"text":" runnerFailureRules: readonly RunnerFailureRule[]"},{"number":157,"text":"}"},{"number":158,"text":"```"},{"number":159,"text":""},{"number":160,"text":"[本地提供方](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/README.zh.md)拥有运维配置，并将其 runner 方言映射到这些规则。[沙箱化 bash 消费方](../../packages/shell/bash-sandbox/README.zh.md)拥有 spawn 与结果归因。"},{"number":161,"text":""},{"number":162,"text":"## 提供方与 fail-closed 错误"},{"number":163,"text":""},{"number":164,"text":"`await ctx.sandbox.confine(argv, policy, signal)` 在执行环境中解析策略路径并返回 `ConfinedArgv`，没有可用后端时以 `SandboxUnavailableError`（错误码 `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`）拒绝，提供方无法为该模式准备主机状态时以 `SandboxPreparationError`（`SANDBOX_PREPARATION_FAILED`、`SANDBOX_INVALID_TEMP_ROOT`）拒绝。可选信号可在启动前取消解析。消费方也可以在 spawn 或观察所返回的 argv 时对失败进行分类；该归因属于消费方约定。对于受限策略，静默的无隔离透传永远不合法。"},{"number":165,"text":""},{"number":166,"text":"提供方选择、探测、缓存和后端特定的强制执行报告归[本地提供方](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/README.zh.md)所有。"},{"number":167,"text":""},{"number":168,"text":""},{"number":169,"text":""},{"number":170,"text":""},{"number":171,"text":""},{"number":172,"text":"## Cordis API"},{"number":173,"text":""},{"number":174,"text":"Generated from source by `scripts/gen-cordis-catalog.ts` (verified fresh by `pnpm run verify-cordis-catalog` in doc-sync; regenerate with `pnpm run gen-cordis-catalog`) — the language sides differ only in locale-specific paired document paths. Signature blocks use a `ts cordis-catalog` fence and keep the original source JSDoc; dispatch modes are defined in the [primer](../cordis-primer.zh.md#dispatch-modes), and the framework-inherited `ctx` API lives in [cordis-api/inherited.md](../cordis-api/inherited.md)."},{"number":175,"text":""},{"number":176,"text":""},{"number":177,"text":""},{"number":178,"text":"### `ctx.sandbox` — `SandboxProvider` (abstract seam)"},{"number":179,"text":""},{"number":180,"text":"Abstract process-sandbox service. confine must return enforcing argv or fail closed at wrap or runner-execution time; silent unconfined passthrough is forbidden. Functional probes arbitrate multi-runner chains and may be skipped for a sole candidate, whose own refusal remains the fail-closed end."},{"number":181,"text":""},{"number":182,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":183,"text":"/**"},{"number":184,"text":" * Wrap `argv` so it executes confined under `policy` on this host; the"},{"number":185,"text":" * caller spawns the returned argv in place of its own."},{"number":186,"text":" * @param argv - the exact argv the caller is about to spawn (program plus"},{"number":187,"text":" * arguments), NOT a shell string — a shell-shaped consumer passes"},{"number":188,"text":" * `['bash', '-c', command]`."},{"number":189,"text":" * @param policy - the file-effect policy this execution runs under,"},{"number":190,"text":" * carried per call (see {@link SandboxPolicy})."},{"number":191,"text":" * @param signal - cancellation while the provider resolves the policy and runner."},{"number":192,"text":" * @returns the argv to spawn instead, plus the enforcement completeness"},{"number":193,"text":" * the selected backend achieves for it."},{"number":194,"text":" */"},{"number":195,"text":"abstract confine(argv: readonly string[], policy: SandboxPolicy, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":196,"text":"```"},{"number":197,"text":""},{"number":198,"text":"Source: [`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts`](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts)"},{"number":199,"text":""},{"number":200,"text":""},{"number":201,"text":""},{"number":202,"text":"### `ctx.sandboxPolicy` — `SandboxPolicyService`"},{"number":203,"text":""},{"number":204,"text":"The sandbox-policy service (`ctx.sandboxPolicy`). Owns the deployment default mode, fallback workspace root, session-scoped directory grants, and request-time policy section. Tool layers call resolve for each execution so a session's mode log and immutable cwd travel together to every enforcing capability."},{"number":205,"text":""},{"number":206,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":207,"text":"/**"},{"number":208,"text":" * Resolve the complete policy for one capability call. An approved explicit"},{"number":209,"text":" * mode outranks the session's last `sandbox/mode` event, which outranks the"},{"number":210,"text":" * deployment default. A session cwd is its workspace-write boundary; the"},{"number":211,"text":" * configured root is the fallback for agentless calls and sessions without a"},{"number":212,"text":" * cwd. Configured extra roots and this Session's active registrations are"},{"number":213,"text":" * snapshotted together; existing operations and processes keep their policy."},{"number":214,"text":" * @param request - optional session and approved mode override."},{"number":215,"text":" * @returns the fully resolved per-call mode and absolute workspace root."},{"number":216,"text":" * @throws `SandboxInvalidRootError` (`SANDBOX_INVALID_ROOT`) when the session's recorded cwd is"},{"number":217,"text":" * relative or contains a NUL byte."},{"number":218,"text":" */"},{"number":219,"text":"resolve(request: SandboxPolicyRequest = {}): SandboxExecutionPolicy"},{"number":220,"text":""},{"number":221,"text":"/**"},{"number":222,"text":" * Permit writes under one directory in this Session's future workspace-write"},{"number":223,"text":" * operations. The calling context owns the effect; disposal removes only this"},{"number":224,"text":" * registration. Other grants to the directory remain effective. Existing"},{"number":225,"text":" * operations and persistent processes retain their resolved permissions."},{"number":226,"text":" * Grants are runtime-only and must be registered again after resume or fork."},{"number":227,"text":" * On Windows, only harness file tools honor extra grants; process permissions stay unchanged."},{"number":228,"text":" * @param session - exact live Session receiving the grant; other Sessions and agentless calls are unaffected."},{"number":229,"text":" * @param directory - absolute execution-world path; execution rejects missing, non-directory, or symlinked paths."},{"number":230,"text":" * @returns the exact Cordis effect disposer for this registration."},{"number":231,"text":" * @throws when the directory is relative or contains a NUL byte."},{"number":232,"text":" */"},{"number":233,"text":"registerWritableRoot(session: Session, directory: string): () => void"},{"number":234,"text":""},{"number":235,"text":"/**"},{"number":236,"text":" * Read the session override without applying the deployment default."},{"number":237,"text":" * @param session - session whose log supplies the override."},{"number":238,"text":" * @returns the last logged mode, or `undefined` without one."},{"number":239,"text":" */"},{"number":240,"text":"overrideOf(session: Session): SandboxMode | undefined"},{"number":241,"text":"```"},{"number":242,"text":""},{"number":243,"text":"Types: [Session](session.zh.md)"},{"number":244,"text":""},{"number":245,"text":"Source: [`packages/sandbox/sandbox-policy/src/index.ts`](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-policy/src/index.ts)"},{"number":246,"text":""}],"totalLines":246,"lang":"md"}},"sourceEventSeqs":[235],"surfaceOp":"append"} {"type":"tool/result","seq":238,"time":1795439814972,"data":{"turn":6,"step":20,"message":{"role":"tool","source":{"kind":"tool","callId":"call_01_fGCxyOksiuCTkrgl2cH04948"},"toolCallId":"call_01_fGCxyOksiuCTkrgl2cH04948","content":[{"type":"text","text":"C:\\Users\\xueha\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\DeepSeek Harness\\resources\\app.asar\\dsh\\node_modules\\@deepseek-ai\\dsh\\docs\\subsystems\\workspace.zh.md\nfile\n\n1: # 工作区\n2: \n3: [English](workspace.md) | 中文\n4: \n5: 工作区（workspace）是用户工作目录的持久记录：一个建立在规范路径之上的稳定 id、一个显示标题，以及归属于它的会话的有序账本。该子系统是单个包（package）（[dsh-workspace](../../packages/workspace/workspace)，`ctx.workspaceRegistry`）——一项宿主侧可选能力，不属于 agent loop（智能体循环）主干，并且对模型不可见（没有工具、没有提示词文本、没有会话事件）。它通过[存储领域数据形式](storage.zh.md)存储自己的记录，并对照 [`SessionHeader.cwd`](persistence.zh.md#sessionheader--metadata-beside-the-log) 校验会话成员资格，因此 `storageDomain` 与 `sessionPersistence` 是必需的启动依赖：持久化这一依赖不可用时，插件保持 pending，而不是把这种不可用误当作空历史。设计记录：[领域 KV 存储 Agent Note（agent 决策记录）](../../.agents/notes/proposed/architecture/2026-07-24-domain-kv-storage-and-workspace.zh.md)；引导与 GUI 顺序：[Workspace UI 产品流程 Agent Note](../../.agents/notes/archived/feature/2026-07-25-workspace-ui-product-flow.md)。\n6: \n7: 源码：[`packages/workspace/workspace/src/types.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/types.ts)\n8: \n9: ## 标识\n10: \n11: ```ts type-equiv\n12: /**\n13: * Identifies one workspace record. A generated uuid, never the path: path\n14: * normalization rewrites paths, and a reference anchor must stay stable.\n15: */\n16: type WorkspaceId = Branded<'WorkspaceId'>\n17: ```\n18: \n19: `WorkspaceId` 是[品牌化 id](core.zh.md#branded-ids)。路径标识与之分离：`realpathNormalize`（`fs.realpath`；尾部斜杠、`..` 与符号链接全部解析）是唯一的一套唯一性规范——工作区路径以规范化形式存储，唯一性即规范路径的字符串相等（指向已被拥有目录的符号链接会与之冲突），attach 时的会话 cwd 检查也走同一套规范。\n20: \n21: ## 工作区实体\n22: \n23: 消费方只看到 `Workspace` 接口；实现保持包内私有。\n24: \n25: ```ts type-equiv\n26: /**\n27: * One workspace: a stable id over an existing directory, a display title, and\n28: * an ordered candidate account of sessions. Membership validates header cwd\n29: * against the workspace path, but preserves an existing account when its\n30: * fully qualified cwd is missing. Consumers only see this interface; the\n31: * implementation stays private.\n32: */\n33: interface Workspace {\n34: /** Stable record id (generated uuid). */\n35: readonly id: WorkspaceId\n36: \n37: /**\n38: * Canonical directory path: the `fs.realpath` of the path given at create\n39: * time (trailing slashes, `..`, and symlinks all resolved). Never rewritten\n40: * afterwards, even when the directory disappears (see {@link status}).\n41: */\n42: readonly path: string\n43: \n44: /** Display title. Defaults to the final path segment, or a filesystem root's own spelling; duplicates are allowed. */\n45: readonly title: string\n46: \n47: /** ISO-8601 creation instant, stamped at create and never rewritten. */\n48: readonly createdAt: string\n49: \n50: /** ISO-8601 instant of the last durable mutation (create counts as one). */\n51: readonly updatedAt: string\n52: \n53: /**\n54: * Header-validated sessions in manually owned order: a new session is\n55: * prepended at attach, explicit reordering goes through\n56: * `insertSessionBefore`, and activity never reorders. The durable candidate\n57: * account is filtered synchronously: missing headers, invalid cwd values,\n58: * and canonical cwd mismatches are never returned. A fully qualified cwd\n59: * whose realpath or directory stat fails with ENOENT preserves an existing\n60: * candidate, including a dangling symlink; other filesystem failures do not.\n61: * A subsequent mutation prunes filtered candidates, not missing-directory\n62: * candidates. This does not admit new sessions or recreate directories.\n63: */\n64: readonly sessionIds: readonly SessionId[]\n65: \n66: /**\n67: * Replace the display title durably.\n68: * @param title - New title; any string, duplicates across workspaces allowed.\n69: * @returns resolution after durability.\n70: */\n71: setTitle(title: string): Promise\n72: \n73: /**\n74: * Prepend a session to this workspace's candidate account. An already\n75: * accounted id resolves without writing, aside from the durable\n76: * filtered-candidate prune every accepted mutation performs. A new id's\n77: * live or persisted\n78: * header cwd must resolve to an existing directory equal to {@link path};\n79: * unknown ids, missing or invalid cwd values, and mismatches reject without\n80: * writing.\n81: * @param sessionId - The session to record.\n82: * @returns resolution after durability.\n83: */\n84: attachSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise\n85: \n86: /**\n87: * Move an accounted session within the manual order, DOM-insertBefore-like:\n88: * with an anchor the session lands before it, without one it appends to the\n89: * end. Only the moved id changes position. A session or anchor absent from\n90: * the account rejects without writing; a move to the current position\n91: * resolves without writing, aside from the durable filtered-candidate\n92: * prune every accepted mutation performs; decided on the domain write\n93: * chain.\n94: * @param sessionId - The accounted session to move.\n95: * @param beforeSessionId - Accounted anchor to insert before; omitted appends.\n96: * @returns resolution after durability.\n97: */\n98: insertSessionBefore(sessionId: SessionId, beforeSessionId?: SessionId): Promise\n99: \n100: /**\n101: * Remove a session from this workspace's account. Idempotent: an id not on\n102: * the account resolves without writing, aside from the durable\n103: * filtered-candidate prune every accepted mutation performs; decided on\n104: * the domain write chain like attach. Never touches the session's own stored log.\n105: * @param sessionId - The session to remove.\n106: * @returns resolution after durability.\n107: */\n108: detachSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise\n109: \n110: /**\n111: * Live directory check, uncached: whether {@link path} currently exists and\n112: * is a directory. A missing directory never mutates the record — the\n113: * directory may only be temporarily moved.\n114: * @returns `'ok'` when the directory exists, `'missing-dir'` otherwise.\n115: */\n116: status(): Promise<'ok' | 'missing-dir'>\n117: }\n118: ```\n119: \n120: 所有权的真源是记录中有序的 `sessionIds`，绝不从会话 cwd 派生。成员资格将记录的 header cwd 与工作区路径校验；已有候选的完全限定 cwd 在路径解析或目录 stat 时返回 `ENOENT`，仍保留其归属。这会保留目录缺失或符号链接失效时的记账关系，但不会接纳新会话。失败的写入会拒绝（`insertSessionBefore` 的账本错误以 `WorkspaceMoveInvalidError` 拒绝，存储失败以普通错误拒绝）；每次被接受的变更都盖上 `updatedAt` 时间戳，并持久修剪不再通过成员资格检查的候选项。\n121: \n122: ## 注册表：`ctx.workspaceRegistry`\n123: \n124: `WorkspaceRegistry`（[签名](#ctxworkspaceregistry--workspaceregistry)）拥有注册与解析。`create(path, title?)` 要求完全限定路径并将其规范化，拒绝不存在的路径（原样传出原始 `ENOENT`）或非目录；当规范路径已被拥有时原样返回既有实体；否则创建一条标题为 `title ?? defaultWorkspaceTitle(path)` 的记录并前插到持久的注册表顺序中（不同规范路径可以共享同一显示标题，没有最终路径段时使用根路径拼写）。`get(id)` 与有序的 `list()` 是同步缓存读取；`resolveByPath(path)` 应用同一套完全限定 realpath 规范但不创建。`delete(id)` 只移除注册记录、顺序条目和会话账本——目录、用户文件、实时会话和已持久化日志一概不动，因此这些会话变为 Ungrouped（[参考](../../packages/workspace/workspace/README.zh.md)）；未知 id 返回 `false`。create 与 delete 会在其两次写入（记录 + 顺序）可能分叉之前先持久写入一个待定变更标记；启动时恰好解决被标记的那次变更——通过删除被标记的表行：这会补完被中断的 delete，并回滚被中断的 create（注册可以重建，因此回滚是安全方向）——而没有标记的顺序/表不一致则作为损坏大声失败。\n125: \n126: 会话的 cwd 在创建时由创建者赋予，而不是由本注册表赋予——API 网关从所选工作区的 `path` 解析新会话的 cwd（回退到显式或默认 cwd），先创建会话使 cwd 落入其不可变的 [`SessionHeader`](persistence.zh.md#sessionheader--metadata-beside-the-log)，再调用 `attachSession`，后者会把已存储的 header cwd 与工作区路径重新校验一遍。首次成功启动时，注册表仅凭已持久化的 header（`id`、`cwd`、`createdAt`——绝不读事件正文）引导历史：把规范 cwd 有效的会话按目录分组为工作区，最新的排在最前；「已初始化」标记最后写入，因此被中断的引导可以安全续跑。引导只发生这一次：没有 cwd 的历史遗留会话保持 Ungrouped，此后创建的会话只能通过 `attachSession` 加入工作区。\n127: \n128: ## 默认工作区初始化\n129: \n130: 控制器的 `initializeDefault` 不接受请求参数：它拥有固定目录名 `default-workspace`，解析 Documents 位置，并请求注册表执行一次初始化。注册表接收目录解析器，以所请求目录（而非规范路径）的最后一段作为初始标题，并将登记与持久化身份一起提交。语言不会传到 Host——浏览器消费方通过控制器的 `workspaceDisplayTitle` 为仍保留该自动标题的工作区加标签，因此只有屏幕上的名称跟随读者语言。[首次使用行为与配置](../../packages/api/workspace-controller/README.zh.md#first-use-workspace)说明复用和失败处理。\n131: \n132: ## 会话置顶\n133: \n134: 控制器的[传输类型](../../packages/api/workspace-controller/src/types.ts)定义了 `WorkspacePinSessionRequest` 和 `WorkspaceUnpinSessionRequest`，两者都携带一个 `sessionId`。两个操作都返回 `WorkspacePinValue`：完整的会话 id 数组 `pinnedSessionIds`，最近置顶的会话排在前面。置顶要求会话已知且未归档；对未置顶的 id 取消置顶会成功，且不改变集合。归档在同一次持久化写入中移除该会话的置顶，取消归档不会恢复置顶。\n135: \n136: ## 归档准入\n137: \n138: 归档是一个注册表全局的持久化集合，注册表拒绝把正在运行的工作藏在它后面。这条规则是本包声明并派发的两个宿主事件之上的能力接缝（[事件](#workspace-events)）：`workspace/session-activity`（waterfall）向已组合的提供方询问某会话还有什么在跑，`workspace/session-stop`（parallel）请它们停止这些工作。每个提供方像任何监听器一样在根上注册，因此本包不认识 agent、job 或 schedule 的词汇；各族是一个可合并扩展的 map 的键。\n139: \n140: ```ts type-equiv\n141: /**\n142: * Activity families a `workspace/session-activity` listener may report. This\n143: * package declares none: each provider merges its own key from a module both\n144: * its Host and Client faces import, so a consumer that renders the families\n145: * sees exactly the keys its program compiled and falls through to a generic\n146: * description for any other. The shipped providers merge `turn` (the Agent\n147: * registry), `job` (the job registry seam), `subagent` (the Subagent\n148: * runtime), and `schedule` (the Schedule plugin).\n149: */\n150: interface SessionActivityKindMap {}\n151: ```\n152: \n153: `SessionActivityKind` 即 `keyof SessionActivityKindMap`，因此一个没有编译任何提供方的程序看不到任何键。随附的键放在各自 client 可导入的类型模块里：`turn` 在 Agent 注册表的 `types.ts`，`job` 在任务注册表接缝的 `view.ts`，`subagent` 在 Subagent runtime 的 `control-types.ts`，`schedule` 在 Schedule 插件的 `types.ts`；渲染各族的消费方为其分支导入这些模块，并为其他任何键保留一条通用文案。提供方通过把自己的 `SessionActivity` 条目前置到 `next()` 的结果来回答 waterfall；注册表最内层的回调返回空列表，因此没有提供方的组合可自由归档。\n154: \n155: ```ts type-equiv\n156: /**\n157: * One reason a session counts as active for archive admission. Families with\n158: * per-item identity list their items so a caller can name what must stop.\n159: */\n160: interface SessionActivity {\n161: readonly kind: SessionActivityKind\n162: /** Active items of the family; absent for a family without per-item identity (`turn`). */\n163: readonly items?: readonly SessionActivityItem[]\n164: }\n165: ```\n166: \n167: `SessionActivityItem` 携带各族自己的 `id`（会话、任务或提醒 id）和可选的展示 `label`。`archiveSession(sessionId)` 在存在性检查之后只询问 waterfall 一次，对非空答案以 `WorkspaceActiveSessionError`（`sessionId`、`activity`）拒绝且不写入；控制器把它映射为 `workspace/session-active` 错误，其 details 携带同样的两个字段。`archiveSession(sessionId, { stopActivity: true })`——`ArchiveSessionOptions` 的这个字段由传输请求以 `stopActivity` 暴露——跳过检查、先写入归档、再派发 `workspace/session-stop`；提供方抛错只记日志，归档保留，被停止的工作从不等待收敛。已归档的 id 既不询问也不停止。随附的提供方、它们停止什么，以及让已归档会话不跑模型步的 `agent/pre-step` 门禁，记录在[注册表包](../../packages/workspace/workspace/README.zh.md#api-behavior)；决策记录见 [archive-stops-running-work Agent Note](../../.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-21-archive-stops-running-session-work.zh.md)。\n168: \n169: ## 消费方\n170: \n171: [`dsh-workspace-controller`](../../packages/api/workspace-controller) 经 `ctx.workspaceRegistry` 向 GUI 客户端提供工作区 CRUD，[`dsh-session-controller`](../../packages/api/session-controller) 执行上文「先建会话再 attach」的流程。[dsh-agent-instructions](../../packages/context/agent-instructions) 尽管名字如此，却**不是**消费方：它在 agent 自己的 cwd 下发现 AGENTS.md 风格的指令文件，从不触碰 `ctx.workspaceRegistry`——两者共用的这个词指的是用户的工作目录，而非本注册表的实体。\n172: \n173: \n174: \n175: \n176: \n177: ## Cordis API\n178: \n179: Generated from source by `scripts/gen-cordis-catalog.ts` (verified fresh by `pnpm run verify-cordis-catalog` in doc-sync; regenerate with `pnpm run gen-cordis-catalog`) — the language sides differ only in locale-specific paired document paths. Signature blocks use a `ts cordis-catalog` fence and keep the original source JSDoc; dispatch modes are defined in the [primer](../cordis-primer.zh.md#dispatch-modes), and the framework-inherited `ctx` API lives in [cordis-api/inherited.md](../cordis-api/inherited.md).\n180: \n181: \n182: \n183: ### `ctx.directoryPicker` — `DirectoryPicker` (abstract seam)\n184: \n185: Abstract directory-picking service. Subclass, implement `capability()`, and load the subclass as a plugin — it registers as `ctx.directoryPicker` (one implementation per context; loading a second throws, cordis' standard duplicate-service behavior). The capability object must be stable for the service lifetime: consumers may capture it across calls.\n186: \n187: ```ts cordis-catalog\n188: /**\n189: * The backend's interaction capability.\n190: * @returns the discriminated capability consumers switch on.\n191: */\n192: abstract capability(): DirectoryPickerCapability\n193: ```\n194: \n195: Source: [`packages/host/directory-picker/src/index.ts`](../../packages/host/directory-picker/src/index.ts)\n196: \n197: \n198: \n199: ### `ctx.directoryPickerController` — `DirectoryPickerController`\n200: \n201: Host service backing the generated `ctx.remote.directoryPicker` namespace. The seam it exports is abstract and therefore never a Loader entry of its own, so this controller carries the wire verbs: one composed backend serves either the native chooser or the browse primitives, and a verb the composition cannot serve is refused rather than approximated.\n202: \n203: ```ts cordis-catalog\n204: /**\n205: * Open the host's OS chooser for a Remote caller.\n206: * @param signal - files outside it are allowed.\n454: * @param range - the line window; omitted fields take the page defaults.\n455: * @param signal - caller cancellation.\n456: * @returns the page, the file's version at the stat before it, and whether it reaches the last line.\n457: */\n458: @Remote async read( workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, range: WorkspaceFileRange, signal: AbortSignal, ): Promise\n459: \n460: /**\n461: * Read a complete regular file or one byte range without text decoding.\n462: * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire.\n463: * @param path - target path, absolute or workspace-relative; relative to the base file's directory when provided.\n464: * @param options - optional base file and range; without a range the complete-file cap applies.\n465: * @param signal - caller cancellation.\n466: * @returns native bytes with the file's version and size at the preceding stat, byte offset, and EOF marker.\n467: */\n468: @Remote async readBytes( workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, options: WorkspaceByteReadOptions, signal: AbortSignal, ): Promise\n469: \n470: /**\n471: * Report one regular file's identity, version, and size without its content.\n472: * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire.\n473: * @param path - absolute path or path relative to the workspace root; files outside it are allowed.\n474: * @param signal - caller cancellation.\n475: * @returns the file's absolute path, current version, and byte size.\n476: */\n477: @Remote async stat(workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise\n478: \n479: /**\n480: * List the direct children of one directory inside the Session's workspace.\n481: * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire.\n482: * @param path - workspace path, absolute or relative to the workspace root.\n483: * @param signal - caller cancellation.\n484: * @returns the directory's children in the backend's stable name order, bounded by the entry cap.\n485: */\n486: @Remote async list(workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise\n487: \n488: /**\n489: * Search files and their inferred ancestor directories with packaged ripgrep.\n490: * Native ignore rules apply unless disabled; VCS metadata, symlinks and empty\n491: * directories are absent. Within the bounded set of listed files, matches\n492: * sort by depth, then workspace-relative path.\n493: * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire.\n494: * @param request - the query, literal exclusions, and hidden/ignore switches.\n495: * @param signal - caller cancellation, forwarded to the subprocess; rejection preserves its reason.\n496: * @returns matches capped by search.maxResults; incomplete marks excess rg files or exit 2.\n497: * @throws RemoteError `gateway/bad-request`: the query is blank.\n498: * @throws RemoteError `workspace-file/not-found`: the workspace root does not exist.\n499: * @throws RemoteError `workspace-file/not-directory`: the workspace root is not a directory.\n500: * @throws RemoteError `workspace-file/search-failed`: subprocess is missing, rg cannot launch or execute, or the search times out.\n501: */\n502: @Remote async search( workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, request: WorkspaceFileSearchRequest, signal: AbortSignal, ): Promise\n503: \n504: /**\n505: * Watch one file or a directory's direct entries in the Session's filesystem.\n506: * Files use the backend's read authority; directories remain workspace-scoped.\n507: * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire.\n508: * @param path - target path; the Host determines its type and confines directories to the workspace.\n509: * @param signal - generation cancellation.\n510: * @returns `ready` once the target watch is active, then current metadata for queued and live invalidations.\n511: * @throws RemoteError when watching is unavailable or a directory is outside the workspace.\n512: */\n513: @Remote({ mode: 'stream' }) changes(workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, signal: AbortSignal): AsyncIterable\n514: ```\n515: \n516: Source: [`packages/api/workspace-files/src/index.ts`](../../packages/api/workspace-files/src/index.ts)\n517: \n518: \n519: \n520: ### `ctx.workspaceRegistry` — `WorkspaceRegistry`\n521: \n522: Durable workspace registry. Startup waits for `sessionPersistence`, builds one canonical-cwd header index, and completes the one-time history bootstrap before the service becomes active. The persistence dependency is mandatory so an unavailable peer can never be mistaken for an empty history and commit the initialized marker.\n523: \n524: ```ts cordis-catalog\n525: /**\n526: * Create or reuse a workspace for an existing directory. The fully qualified\n527: * path is canonicalized through `fs.realpath`; a relative, nonexistent, or\n528: * non-directory path rejects. Repeated calls for the same canonical path\n529: * return the existing entity without changing its title.\n530: * A newly created workspace is prepended to the durable registry order.\n531: * Different canonical paths may share a display title.\n532: * @param path - Existing directory to own, in a fully qualified path spelling.\n533: * @param title - Display title used only when a new record is created.\n534: * @returns the existing or newly durable workspace.\n535: */\n536: async create(path: string, title?: string): Promise\n537: \n538: /**\n539: * Initialize the default Workspace only while both the registry and Session\n540: * history are empty. Unknown ids are an idempotent no-op for domain callers.\n572: * @param id - Workspace registration to remove.\n573: * @returns `true` when a record was deleted, `false` when it was unknown.\n574: */\n575: delete(id: WorkspaceId): Promise\n576: \n577: /**\n578: * Move one workspace within the durable display order, DOM-insertBefore-like.\n579: * With an anchor it lands before that workspace; without one it appends.\n580: * @param id - Workspace to move.\n581: * @param beforeId - Workspace anchor; omitted appends.\n582: * @returns the complete committed workspace order.\n583: */\n584: insertBefore(id: WorkspaceId, beforeId?: WorkspaceId): Promise\n585: \n586: /**\n587: * Archive one session durably. The session must exist (live or in session\n588: * persistence); its workspace accounting — or lack of one — is irrelevant.\n589: * Without `stopActivity` the session must also be inactive: the\n590: * `workspace/session-activity` waterfall is asked once, and any reported\n591: * activity rejects with {@link WorkspaceActiveSessionError} before anything\n592: * is written. With `stopActivity` the archive is written without an\n593: * activity check, and the `workspace/session-stop` providers are then asked\n594: * to stop the session's work: the durable archive set is what a provider's\n595: * `agent/pre-step` gate reads, so every wake the stops induce is already\n596: * blocked. An already archived id\n598: * resolves without writing, asking, or stopping.\n599: * @param sessionId - The session to archive.\n600: * @param options - Whether running work is stopped instead of refusing.\n601: * @returns resolution after durability, any stop requests, and follow-up admission.\n602: */\n603: archiveSession(sessionId: SessionId, options: ArchiveSessionOptions = {}): Promise\n604: \n605: /**\n606: * Unarchive one session durably by dropping it from the registry-global\n607: * archive set; the accounting slot was never touched, so the session\n608: * returns to its recorded position. An id that is not archived\n611: * resolves without writing.\n612: * @param sessionId - The session to unarchive.\n613: * @returns resolution after durability.\n614: */\n615: unarchiveSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise\n616: \n617: /**\n618: * Pin one session durably, prepending it to the registry-global pin set.\n619: * The session must exist (live or in session persistence) and must not be\n620: * archived. An already pinned id resolves without writing or reordering.\n621: * @param sessionId - The session to pin.\n622: * @returns resolution after durability.\n623: */\n624: pinSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise\n625: \n626: /**\n627: * Unpin one session durably by dropping it from the registry-global pin\n628: * set. Unpinning runs no session-existence check because removing an id\n629: * cannot introduce an unknown one, so an entry whose session is gone still\n630: * resolves. An id that is not pinned resolves without writing.\n631: * @param sessionId - The session to unpin.\n632: * @returns resolution after durability.\n633: */\n634: unpinSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise\n635: \n636: /**\n637: * Resolve by canonical directory path without creating or mutating a\n638: * workspace. A missing path rejects during `realpath`; an existing unowned\n639: * directory returns `undefined`.\n640: * @param path - Existing directory path in a fully qualified spelling.\n641: * @returns the workspace owning the canonical path, when one exists.\n642: */\n643: async resolveByPath(path: string): Promise\n644: ```\n645: \n646: Types: [SessionId](core.zh.md)\n647: \n648: Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)\n649: \n650: \n651: \n652: ### `workspace/*` events\n653: \n654: \n655: \n656: #### `workspace/session-activity` — waterfall\n657: \n658: Ask the composed providers what still runs for a session before it is archived. A listener prepends its own SessionActivity entries to the result of `next()`; the registry's innermost callback returns an empty list, so a composition without providers archives freely. Any non-empty result refuses the archive without a write.\n659: \n660: ```ts cordis-catalog\n661: /**\n662: * Ask the composed providers what still runs for a session before it is\n663: * archived. A listener prepends its own {@link SessionActivity} entries to\n664: * the result of `next()`; the registry's innermost callback returns an\n665: * empty list, so a composition without providers archives freely. Any\n666: * non-empty result refuses the archive without a write.\n667: * @param request - the session about to be archived.\n668: * @param next - delegate to the remaining providers.\n669: * @mode waterfall\n670: */\n671: 'workspace/session-activity'( request: SessionActivityRequest, next: () => Promise, ): Promise\n672: ```\n673: \n674: Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)\n675: \n676: \n677: \n678: #### `workspace/session-archived` — parallel\n679: \n680: Admit optional follow-up work after durable archival and any stop requests. Dispatched inside the registry's write queue: a listener registers its work and returns, and runs the work and any unbounded I/O afterwards. Listener failures are logged without undoing archival. Listeners own and drain their background work.\n681: \n682: ```ts cordis-catalog\n683: /**\n684: * Admit optional follow-up work after durable archival and any stop requests.\n685: * Dispatched inside the registry's write queue: a listener registers its work\n686: * and returns, and runs the work and any unbounded I/O afterwards. Listener\n687: * failures are logged without undoing archival. Listeners own and drain their background work.\n688: * @param request - newly archived Session; repeated archive requests do not dispatch.\n689: * @mode parallel\n690: */\n691: 'workspace/session-archived'(request: SessionActivityRequest): Promise | void\n692: ```\n693: \n694: Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)\n695: \n696: \n697: \n698: #### `workspace/session-stop` — parallel\n699: \n700: Stop a session's running work because the caller archived it with `stopActivity`; the archive set is durable when this dispatches. Each provider stops its own families — cancelling a turn, its subagent descendants, owned jobs, or active schedules — through the same cancel paths the user's own stop actions use, so the session log ends every open turn regularly and a later unarchive can continue the conversation. Listeners issue their stop requests without waiting for running work to settle; a listener may await its own durability barrier. A rejection is logged by the registry and does not undo the archive.\n701: \n702: ```ts cordis-catalog\n703: /**\n704: * Stop a session's running work because the caller archived it with\n705: * `stopActivity`; the archive set is durable when this dispatches. Each\n706: * provider stops its own families — cancelling a turn, its subagent\n707: * descendants, owned jobs, or active schedules — through the same cancel\n708: * paths the user's own stop actions use, so the session log ends every\n709: * open turn regularly and a later unarchive can continue the\n710: * conversation. Listeners issue their stop requests without waiting for\n711: * running work to settle; a listener may await its own durability\n712: * barrier. A rejection is logged by the registry and does not undo the\n713: * archive.\n714: * @param request - the session being archived.\n715: * @mode parallel\n716: */\n717: 'workspace/session-stop'(request: SessionActivityRequest): Promise | void\n718: ```\n719: \n720: Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)\n721: \n722: \n723: \n724: #### `workspace/session-unarchiving` — parallel\n725: \n726: Cancel or settle archive follow-up work before making a Session available again.
