A generated uuid, never the path: path"},{"number":14,"text":" * normalization rewrites paths, and a reference anchor must stay stable."},{"number":15,"text":" */"},{"number":16,"text":"type WorkspaceId = Branded<'WorkspaceId'>"},{"number":17,"text":"```"},{"number":18,"text":""},{"number":19,"text":"`WorkspaceId` 是[品牌化 id](core.zh.md#branded-ids)。路径标识与之分离：`realpathNormalize`（`fs.realpath`；尾部斜杠、`..` 与符号链接全部解析）是唯一的一套唯一性规范——工作区路径以规范化形式存储，唯一性即规范路径的字符串相等（指向已被拥有目录的符号链接会与之冲突），attach 时的会话 cwd 检查也走同一套规范。"},{"number":20,"text":""},{"number":21,"text":"## 工作区实体"},{"number":22,"text":""},{"number":23,"text":"消费方只看到 `Workspace` 接口；实现保持包内私有。"},{"number":24,"text":""},{"number":25,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":26,"text":"/**"},{"number":27,"text":" * One workspace: a stable id over an existing directory, a display title, and"},{"number":28,"text":" * an ordered candidate account of sessions. Membership validates header cwd"},{"number":29,"text":" * against the workspace path, but preserves an existing account when its"},{"number":30,"text":" * fully qualified cwd is missing. Consumers only see this interface; the"},{"number":31,"text":" * implementation stays private."},{"number":32,"text":" */"},{"number":33,"text":"interface Workspace {"},{"number":34,"text":" /** Stable record id (generated uuid). */"},{"number":35,"text":" readonly id: WorkspaceId"},{"number":36,"text":""},{"number":37,"text":" /**"},{"number":38,"text":" * Canonical directory path: the `fs.realpath` of the path given at create"},{"number":39,"text":" * time (trailing slashes, `..`, and symlinks all resolved). Never rewritten"},{"number":40,"text":" * afterwards, even when the directory disappears (see {@link status})."},{"number":41,"text":" */"},{"number":42,"text":" readonly path: string"},{"number":43,"text":""},{"number":44,"text":" /** Display title. Defaults to the final path segment, or a filesystem root's own spelling; duplicates are allowed. */"},{"number":45,"text":" readonly title: string"},{"number":46,"text":""},{"number":47,"text":" /** ISO-8601 creation instant, stamped at create and never rewritten. */"},{"number":48,"text":" readonly createdAt: string"},{"number":49,"text":""},{"number":50,"text":" /** ISO-8601 instant of the last durable mutation (create counts as one). */"},{"number":51,"text":" readonly updatedAt: string"},{"number":52,"text":""},{"number":53,"text":" /**"},{"number":54,"text":" * Header-validated sessions in manually owned order: a new session is"},{"number":55,"text":" * prepended at attach, explicit reordering goes through"},{"number":56,"text":" * `insertSessionBefore`, and activity never reorders. The durable candidate"},{"number":57,"text":" * account is filtered synchronously: missing headers, invalid cwd values,"},{"number":58,"text":" * and canonical cwd mismatches are never returned. A fully qualified cwd"},{"number":59,"text":" * whose realpath or directory stat fails with ENOENT preserves an existing"},{"number":60,"text":" * candidate, including a dangling symlink; other filesystem failures do not."},{"number":61,"text":" * A subsequent mutation prunes filtered candidates, not missing-directory"},{"number":62,"text":" * candidates. This does not admit new sessions or recreate directories."},{"number":63,"text":" */"},{"number":64,"text":" readonly sessionIds: readonly SessionId[]"},{"number":65,"text":""},{"number":66,"text":" /**"},{"number":67,"text":" * Replace the display title durably."},{"number":68,"text":" * @param title - New title; any string, duplicates across workspaces allowed."},{"number":69,"text":" * @returns resolution after durability."},{"number":70,"text":" */"},{"number":71,"text":" setTitle(title: string): Promise"},{"number":72,"text":""},{"number":73,"text":" /**"},{"number":74,"text":" * Prepend a session to this workspace's candidate account. An already"},{"number":75,"text":" * accounted id resolves without writing, aside from the durable"},{"number":76,"text":" * filtered-candidate prune every accepted mutation performs. A new id's"},{"number":77,"text":" * live or persisted"},{"number":78,"text":" * header cwd must resolve to an existing directory equal to {@link path};"},{"number":79,"text":" * unknown ids, missing or invalid cwd values, and mismatches reject without"},{"number":80,"text":" * writing."},{"number":81,"text":" * @param sessionId - The session to record."},{"number":82,"text":" * @returns resolution after durability."},{"number":83,"text":" */"},{"number":84,"text":" attachSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise"},{"number":85,"text":""},{"number":86,"text":" /**"},{"number":87,"text":" * Move an accounted session within the manual order, DOM-insertBefore-like:"},{"number":88,"text":" * with an anchor the session lands before it, without one it appends to the"},{"number":89,"text":" * end. Only the moved id changes position. A session or anchor absent from"},{"number":90,"text":" * the account rejects without writing; a move to the current position"},{"number":91,"text":" * resolves without writing, aside from the durable filtered-candidate"},{"number":92,"text":" * prune every accepted mutation performs; decided on the domain write"},{"number":93,"text":" * chain."},{"number":94,"text":" * @param sessionId - The accounted session to move."},{"number":95,"text":" * @param beforeSessionId - Accounted anchor to insert before; omitted appends."},{"number":96,"text":" * @returns resolution after durability."},{"number":97,"text":" */"},{"number":98,"text":" insertSessionBefore(sessionId: SessionId, beforeSessionId?: SessionId): Promise"},{"number":99,"text":""},{"number":100,"text":" /**"},{"number":101,"text":" * Remove a session from this workspace's account. Idempotent: an id not on"},{"number":102,"text":" * the account resolves without writing, aside from the durable"},{"number":103,"text":" * filtered-candidate prune every accepted mutation performs; decided on"},{"number":104,"text":" * the domain write chain like attach. Never touches the session's own stored log."},{"number":105,"text":" * @param sessionId - The session to remove."},{"number":106,"text":" * @returns resolution after durability."},{"number":107,"text":" */"},{"number":108,"text":" detachSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise"},{"number":109,"text":""},{"number":110,"text":" /**"},{"number":111,"text":" * Live directory check, uncached: whether {@link path} currently exists and"},{"number":112,"text":" * is a directory. A missing directory never mutates the record — the"},{"number":113,"text":" * directory may only be temporarily moved."},{"number":114,"text":" * @returns `'ok'` when the directory exists, `'missing-dir'` otherwise."},{"number":115,"text":" */"},{"number":116,"text":" status(): Promise<'ok' | 'missing-dir'>"},{"number":117,"text":"}"},{"number":118,"text":"```"},{"number":119,"text":""},{"number":120,"text":"所有权的真源是记录中有序的 `sessionIds`，绝不从会话 cwd 派生。成员资格将记录的 header cwd 与工作区路径校验；已有候选的完全限定 cwd 在路径解析或目录 stat 时返回 `ENOENT`，仍保留其归属。这会保留目录缺失或符号链接失效时的记账关系，但不会接纳新会话。失败的写入会拒绝（`insertSessionBefore` 的账本错误以 `WorkspaceMoveInvalidError` 拒绝，存储失败以普通错误拒绝）；每次被接受的变更都盖上 `updatedAt` 时间戳，并持久修剪不再通过成员资格检查的候选项。"},{"number":121,"text":""},{"number":122,"text":"## 注册表：`ctx.workspaceRegistry`"},{"number":123,"text":""},{"number":124,"text":"`WorkspaceRegistry`（[签名](#ctxworkspaceregistry--workspaceregistry)）拥有注册与解析。`create(path, title?)` 要求完全限定路径并将其规范化，拒绝不存在的路径（原样传出原始 `ENOENT`）或非目录；当规范路径已被拥有时原样返回既有实体；否则创建一条标题为 `title ?? defaultWorkspaceTitle(path)` 的记录并前插到持久的注册表顺序中（不同规范路径可以共享同一显示标题，没有最终路径段时使用根路径拼写）。`get(id)` 与有序的 `list()` 是同步缓存读取；`resolveByPath(path)` 应用同一套完全限定 realpath 规范但不创建。`delete(id)` 只移除注册记录、顺序条目和会话账本——目录、用户文件、实时会话和已持久化日志一概不动，因此这些会话变为 Ungrouped（[参考](../../packages/workspace/workspace/README.zh.md)）；未知 id 返回 `false`。create 与 delete 会在其两次写入（记录 + 顺序）可能分叉之前先持久写入一个待定变更标记；启动时恰好解决被标记的那次变更——通过删除被标记的表行：这会补完被中断的 delete，并回滚被中断的 create（注册可以重建，因此回滚是安全方向）——而没有标记的顺序/表不一致则作为损坏大声失败。"},{"number":125,"text":""},{"number":126,"text":"会话的 cwd 在创建时由创建者赋予，而不是由本注册表赋予——API 网关从所选工作区的 `path` 解析新会话的 cwd（回退到显式或默认 cwd），先创建会话使 cwd 落入其不可变的 [`SessionHeader`](persistence.zh.md#sessionheader--metadata-beside-the-log)，再调用 `attachSession`，后者会把已存储的 header cwd 与工作区路径重新校验一遍。首次成功启动时，注册表仅凭已持久化的 header（`id`、`cwd`、`createdAt`——绝不读事件正文）引导历史：把规范 cwd 有效的会话按目录分组为工作区，最新的排在最前；「已初始化」标记最后写入，因此被中断的引导可以安全续跑。引导只发生这一次：没有 cwd 的历史遗留会话保持 Ungrouped，此后创建的会话只能通过 `attachSession` 加入工作区。"},{"number":127,"text":""},{"number":128,"text":"## 默认工作区初始化"},{"number":129,"text":""},{"number":130,"text":"控制器的 `initializeDefault` 不接受请求参数：它拥有固定目录名 `default-workspace`，解析 Documents 位置，并请求注册表执行一次初始化。注册表接收目录解析器，以所请求目录（而非规范路径）的最后一段作为初始标题，并将登记与持久化身份一起提交。语言不会传到 Host——浏览器消费方通过控制器的 `workspaceDisplayTitle` 为仍保留该自动标题的工作区加标签，因此只有屏幕上的名称跟随读者语言。[首次使用行为与配置](../../packages/api/workspace-controller/README.zh.md#first-use-workspace)说明复用和失败处理。"},{"number":131,"text":""},{"number":132,"text":"## 会话置顶"},{"number":133,"text":""},{"number":134,"text":"控制器的[传输类型](../../packages/api/workspace-controller/src/types.ts)定义了 `WorkspacePinSessionRequest` 和 `WorkspaceUnpinSessionRequest`，两者都携带一个 `sessionId`。两个操作都返回 `WorkspacePinValue`：完整的会话 id 数组 `pinnedSessionIds`，最近置顶的会话排在前面。置顶要求会话已知且未归档；对未置顶的 id 取消置顶会成功，且不改变集合。归档在同一次持久化写入中移除该会话的置顶，取消归档不会恢复置顶。"},{"number":135,"text":""},{"number":136,"text":"## 归档准入"},{"number":137,"text":""},{"number":138,"text":"归档是一个注册表全局的持久化集合，注册表拒绝把正在运行的工作藏在它后面。这条规则是本包声明并派发的两个宿主事件之上的能力接缝（[事件](#workspace-events)）：`workspace/session-activity`（waterfall）向已组合的提供方询问某会话还有什么在跑，`workspace/session-stop`（parallel）请它们停止这些工作。每个提供方像任何监听器一样在根上注册，因此本包不认识 agent、job 或 schedule 的词汇；各族是一个可合并扩展的 map 的键。"},{"number":139,"text":""},{"number":140,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":141,"text":"/**"},{"number":142,"text":" * Activity families a `workspace/session-activity` listener may report. This"},{"number":143,"text":" * package declares none: each provider merges its own key from a module both"},{"number":144,"text":" * its Host and Client faces import, so a consumer that renders the families"},{"number":145,"text":" * sees exactly the keys its program compiled and falls through to a generic"},{"number":146,"text":" * description for any other. The shipped providers merge `turn` (the Agent"},{"number":147,"text":" * registry), `job` (the job registry seam), `subagent` (the Subagent"},{"number":148,"text":" * runtime), and `schedule` (the Schedule plugin)."},{"number":149,"text":" */"},{"number":150,"text":"interface SessionActivityKindMap {}"},{"number":151,"text":"```"},{"number":152,"text":""},{"number":153,"text":"`SessionActivityKind` 即 `keyof SessionActivityKindMap`，因此一个没有编译任何提供方的程序看不到任何键。随附的键放在各自 client 可导入的类型模块里：`turn` 在 Agent 注册表的 `types.ts`，`job` 在任务注册表接缝的 `view.ts`，`subagent` 在 Subagent runtime 的 `control-types.ts`，`schedule` 在 Schedule 插件的 `types.ts`；渲染各族的消费方为其分支导入这些模块，并为其他任何键保留一条通用文案。提供方通过把自己的 `SessionActivity` 条目前置到 `next()` 的结果来回答 waterfall；注册表最内层的回调返回空列表，因此没有提供方的组合可自由归档。"},{"number":154,"text":""},{"number":155,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":156,"text":"/**"},{"number":157,"text":" * One reason a session counts as active for archive admission. Families with"},{"number":158,"text":" * per-item identity list their items so a caller can name what must stop."},{"number":159,"text":" */"},{"number":160,"text":"interface SessionActivity {"},{"number":161,"text":" readonly kind: SessionActivityKind"},{"number":162,"text":" /** Active items of the family; absent for a family without per-item identity (`turn`). */"},{"number":163,"text":" readonly items?: readonly SessionActivityItem[]"},{"number":164,"text":"}"},{"number":165,"text":"```"},{"number":166,"text":""},{"number":167,"text":"`SessionActivityItem` 携带各族自己的 `id`（会话、任务或提醒 id）和可选的展示 `label`。`archiveSession(sessionId)` 在存在性检查之后只询问 waterfall 一次，对非空答案以 `WorkspaceActiveSessionError`（`sessionId`、`activity`）拒绝且不写入；控制器把它映射为 `workspace/session-active` 错误，其 details 携带同样的两个字段。`archiveSession(sessionId, { stopActivity: true })`——`ArchiveSessionOptions` 的这个字段由传输请求以 `stopActivity` 暴露——跳过检查、先写入归档、再派发 `workspace/session-stop`；提供方抛错只记日志，归档保留，被停止的工作从不等待收敛。已归档的 id 既不询问也不停止。随附的提供方、它们停止什么，以及让已归档会话不跑模型步的 `agent/pre-step` 门禁，记录在[注册表包](../../packages/workspace/workspace/README.zh.md#api-behavior)；决策记录见 [archive-stops-running-work Agent Note](../../.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-21-archive-stops-running-session-work.zh.md)。"},{"number":168,"text":""},{"number":169,"text":"## 消费方"},{"number":170,"text":""},{"number":171,"text":"[`dsh-workspace-controller`](../../packages/api/workspace-controller) 经 `ctx.workspaceRegistry` 向 GUI 客户端提供工作区 CRUD，[`dsh-session-controller`](../../packages/api/session-controller) 执行上文「先建会话再 attach」的流程。[dsh-agent-instructions](../../packages/context/agent-instructions) 尽管名字如此，却**不是**消费方：它在 agent 自己的 cwd 下发现 AGENTS.md 风格的指令文件，从不触碰 `ctx.workspaceRegistry`——两者共用的这个词指的是用户的工作目录，而非本注册表的实体。"},{"number":172,"text":""},{"number":173,"text":""},{"number":174,"text":""},{"number":175,"text":""},{"number":176,"text":""},{"number":177,"text":"## Cordis API"},{"number":178,"text":""},{"number":179,"text":"Generated from source by `scripts/gen-cordis-catalog.ts` (verified fresh by `pnpm run verify-cordis-catalog` in doc-sync; regenerate with `pnpm run gen-cordis-catalog`) — the language sides differ only in locale-specific paired document paths. Signature blocks use a `ts cordis-catalog` fence and keep the original source JSDoc; dispatch modes are defined in the [primer](../cordis-primer.zh.md#dispatch-modes), and the framework-inherited `ctx` API lives in [cordis-api/inherited.md](../cordis-api/inherited.md)."},{"number":180,"text":""},{"number":181,"text":""},{"number":182,"text":""},{"number":183,"text":"### `ctx.directoryPicker` — `DirectoryPicker` (abstract seam)"},{"number":184,"text":""},{"number":185,"text":"Abstract directory-picking service. Subclass, implement `capability()`, and load the subclass as a plugin — it registers as `ctx.directoryPicker` (one implementation per context; loading a second throws, cordis' standard duplicate-service behavior). The capability object must be stable for the service lifetime: consumers may capture it across calls."},{"number":186,"text":""},{"number":187,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":188,"text":"/**"},{"number":189,"text":" * The backend's interaction capability."},{"number":190,"text":" * @returns the discriminated capability consumers switch on."},{"number":191,"text":" */"},{"number":192,"text":"abstract capability(): DirectoryPickerCapability"},{"number":193,"text":"```"},{"number":194,"text":""},{"number":195,"text":"Source: [`packages/host/directory-picker/src/index.ts`](../../packages/host/directory-picker/src/index.ts)"},{"number":196,"text":""},{"number":197,"text":""},{"number":198,"text":""},{"number":199,"text":"### `ctx.directoryPickerController` — `DirectoryPickerController`"},{"number":200,"text":""},{"number":201,"text":"Host service backing the generated `ctx.remote.directoryPicker` namespace. The seam it exports is abstract and therefore never a Loader entry of its own, so this controller carries the wire verbs: one composed backend serves either the native chooser or the browse primitives, and a verb the composition cannot serve is refused rather than approximated."},{"number":202,"text":""},{"number":203,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":204,"text":"/**"},{"number":205,"text":" * Open the host's OS chooser for a Remote caller."},{"number":206,"text":" * @param signal - caller lifetime; abort terminates the chooser."},{"number":207,"text":" * @returns the chosen absolute path, or null when the operator cancels."},{"number":208,"text":" */"},{"number":209,"text":"@Remote('pick') async pick(signal: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":210,"text":""},{"number":211,"text":"/**"},{"number":212,"text":" * List one directory level for a Remote caller's in-app browser."},{"number":213,"text":" * @param path - absolute directory to list; absent lists the home directory."},{"number":214,"text":" * @param signal - caller lifetime; abort stops the backend's scan instead of"},{"number":215,"text":" * letting it outlive a disconnected caller."},{"number":216,"text":" * @returns the level's listing with its ancestry."},{"number":217,"text":" */"},{"number":218,"text":"@Remote('list') async list(path: string | undefined, signal: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":219,"text":""},{"number":220,"text":"/**"},{"number":221,"text":" * Create one child directory for a Remote caller's in-app browser."},{"number":222,"text":" * @param path - absolute existing parent directory."},{"number":223,"text":" * @param name - single non-blank path segment."},{"number":224,"text":" * @returns the created directory's absolute path."},{"number":225,"text":" */"},{"number":226,"text":"@Remote('createDirectory') async createDirectory(path: string, name: string): Promise"},{"number":227,"text":"```"},{"number":228,"text":""},{"number":229,"text":"Source: [`packages/api/workspace-controller/src/directory-picker.ts`](../../packages/api/workspace-controller/src/directory-picker.ts)"},{"number":230,"text":""},{"number":231,"text":""},{"number":232,"text":""},{"number":233,"text":"### `ctx.terminalController` — `TerminalController`"},{"number":234,"text":""},{"number":235,"text":"Typed Remote control of transient Session-owned terminal processes."},{"number":236,"text":""},{"number":237,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":238,"text":"/**"},{"number":239,"text":" * Read the Session's current directory and terminal limits without filesystem validation or shell lookup."},{"number":240,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner supplied by the Gateway."},{"number":241,"text":" * @param signal - request cancellation."},{"number":242,"text":" * @returns the logged current directory and terminal limits; retained terminals keep their own process directories."},{"number":243,"text":" */"},{"number":244,"text":"@Remote environment(agent: Agent, signal: AbortSignal): TerminalEnvironment"},{"number":245,"text":""},{"number":246,"text":"/**"},{"number":247,"text":" * Discover installed shells in the Session's execution environment."},{"number":248,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner supplied by the Gateway."},{"number":249,"text":" * @param signal - request cancellation."},{"number":250,"text":" * @returns verified profiles, with the configured or system default first."},{"number":251,"text":" */"},{"number":252,"text":"@Remote shells(agent: Agent, signal: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":253,"text":""},{"number":254,"text":"/**"},{"number":255,"text":" * List retained terminals without resolving or activating an Agent."},{"number":256,"text":" * @param sessionId - displayed Session identity, including offline history."},{"number":257,"text":" * @returns terminals retained for this Host lifetime."},{"number":258,"text":" */"},{"number":259,"text":"@Remote list(sessionId: SessionId): WebTerminalInfo[]"},{"number":260,"text":""},{"number":261,"text":"/**"},{"number":262,"text":" * Allocate a user shell once for a caller-generated identity, without Agent sandbox or approval restrictions."},{"number":263,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner supplied by the Gateway."},{"number":264,"text":" * @param request - initial dimensions and idempotency identity."},{"number":265,"text":" * @param signal - allocation cancellation; committed terminals survive disconnection."},{"number":266,"text":" * @returns the existing or newly committed terminal."},{"number":267,"text":" */"},{"number":268,"text":"@Remote async create(agent: Agent, request: TerminalCreateRequest, signal: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":269,"text":""},{"number":270,"text":"/**"},{"number":271,"text":" * Open a terminal for the Session's Agent under a caller-resolved sandbox policy; it appears in every"},{"number":272,"text":" * window that watches the Session and passes to the person on the person's first typed input."},{"number":273,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner whose Agent requests the terminal."},{"number":274,"text":" * @param request - title, directory, dimensions, sandbox policy and shell preference."},{"number":275,"text":" * @param signal - allocation cancellation; a committed terminal outlives it."},{"number":276,"text":" * @returns the Agent's handle for the committed terminal."},{"number":277,"text":" * @throws RemoteError `terminal/limit-reached` when the Session or Agent terminal limit is reached."},{"number":278,"text":" * @throws Error when the title is blank or longer than 120 characters."},{"number":279,"text":" */"},{"number":280,"text":"async openForAgent(agent: Agent, request: AgentTerminalRequest, signal: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":281,"text":""},{"number":282,"text":"/**"},{"number":283,"text":" * Render a page of any terminal in the Agent's Session, including terminals the person opened."},{"number":284,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner."},{"number":285,"text":" * @param id - terminal identity."},{"number":286,"text":" * @param request - page position and byte bound."},{"number":287,"text":" * @returns rendered screen text, including output received before the call."},{"number":288,"text":" * @throws RemoteError `terminal/unavailable` when the terminal is missing or closes before the screen is read."},{"number":289,"text":" */"},{"number":290,"text":"readScreen(agent: Agent, id: WebTerminalId, request: TerminalScreenRequest): Promise"},{"number":291,"text":""},{"number":292,"text":"/**"},{"number":293,"text":" * Observe whether a Session terminal's shell is running a command."},{"number":294,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner."},{"number":295,"text":" * @param id - terminal identity."},{"number":296,"text":" * @returns idle, busy, or unknown for unsupported shells and sandboxed launches."},{"number":297,"text":" */"},{"number":298,"text":"inspectActivity(agent: Agent, id: WebTerminalId): Promise<'idle' | 'busy' | 'unknown'>"},{"number":299,"text":""},{"number":300,"text":"/**"},{"number":301,"text":" * Stream the Session's retained terminals as whole sets, without resolving or activating an Agent."},{"number":302,"text":" * @param sessionId - watched Session identity."},{"number":303,"text":" * @param signal - stream cancellation."},{"number":304,"text":" * @returns the current set, then a new set after creation, removal or any published state change."},{"number":305,"text":" */"},{"number":306,"text":"@Remote({ mode: 'stream' }) async *watch(sessionId: SessionId, signal: AbortSignal): AsyncIterable"},{"number":307,"text":""},{"number":308,"text":"/**"},{"number":309,"text":" * Retain an existing terminal for a window without activating its Agent or taking input control."},{"number":310,"text":" * @param sessionId - owning Session identity, including an inactive saved layout."},{"number":311,"text":" * @param id - retained Host terminal identity."},{"number":312,"text":" * @param signal - physical Remote stream cancellation."},{"number":313,"text":" * @returns a hold acknowledgement followed by an open lifetime stream."},{"number":314,"text":" */"},{"number":315,"text":"@Remote({ mode: 'stream' }) retain(sessionId: SessionId, id: WebTerminalId, signal: AbortSignal): AsyncIterable"},{"number":316,"text":""},{"number":317,"text":"/**"},{"number":318,"text":" * Attach terminal input and output to one physical Remote stream."},{"number":319,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner supplied by the Gateway."},{"number":320,"text":" * @param id - terminal identity."},{"number":321,"text":" * @param signal - attachment cancellation; the process remains alive and input is never replayed."},{"number":322,"text":" * @returns screen recovery, output, writable state and provider-acceptance acknowledgements."},{"number":323,"text":" */"},{"number":324,"text":"@Remote({ mode: 'stream' }) attach(agent: Agent, id: WebTerminalId, signal: AbortSignal): RemoteStream"},{"number":325,"text":""},{"number":326,"text":"/**"},{"number":327,"text":" * Rename a terminal without changing its shell."},{"number":328,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner supplied by the Gateway."},{"number":329,"text":" * @param id - terminal identity."},{"number":330,"text":" * @param title - nonempty display title, at most 120 characters."},{"number":331,"text":" */"},{"number":332,"text":"@Remote rename(agent: Agent, id: WebTerminalId, title: string): void"},{"number":333,"text":""},{"number":334,"text":"/**"},{"number":335,"text":" * Close an identity to future creation and kill its process range; repeated closes succeed."},{"number":336,"text":" * @param agent - Session owner supplied by the Gateway."},{"number":337,"text":" * @param id - terminal identity."},{"number":338,"text":" * @returns after provider cleanup succeeds. A failure retains the terminal for retry."},{"number":339,"text":" */"},{"number":340,"text":"@Remote async close(agent: Agent, id: WebTerminalId): Promise"},{"number":341,"text":"```"},{"number":342,"text":""},{"number":343,"text":"Types: [Agent](core.zh.md) · [RemoteStream](typert.zh.md) · [SessionId](core.zh.md)"},{"number":344,"text":""},{"number":345,"text":"Source: [`packages/api/terminal-controller/src/index.ts`](../../packages/api/terminal-controller/src/index.ts)"},{"number":346,"text":""},{"number":347,"text":""},{"number":348,"text":""},{"number":349,"text":"### `ctx.workspaceController` — `WorkspaceController`"},{"number":350,"text":""},{"number":351,"text":"Host service backing the generated `ctx.remote.workspace` namespace."},{"number":352,"text":""},{"number":353,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":354,"text":"/**"},{"number":355,"text":" * Create or idempotently resolve one Workspace over an existing directory."},{"number":356,"text":" * @param request - directory path to register."},{"number":357,"text":" * @returns the Workspace and whether this call created it."},{"number":358,"text":" */"},{"number":359,"text":"@Remote('create') create(request: WorkspaceCreateRequest): Promise"},{"number":360,"text":""},{"number":361,"text":"/**"},{"number":362,"text":" * Initialize or reuse the default Workspace during first-use startup. The"},{"number":363,"text":" * directory name is fixed, so the Host never renames or relocates an"},{"number":364,"text":" * existing default; its initial title is that same name, which browser"},{"number":365,"text":" * consumers label in the reader's language."},{"number":366,"text":" * @param signal - caller lifetime; cancels native directory lookup."},{"number":367,"text":" * @returns the durable Workspace, or undefined when first-use initialization is ineligible; creates no Session or message."},{"number":368,"text":" */"},{"number":369,"text":"@Remote('initializeDefault') async initializeDefault(signal: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":370,"text":""},{"number":371,"text":"/**"},{"number":372,"text":" * Rename one Workspace to a unique non-blank title."},{"number":373,"text":" * @param request - Workspace identity and proposed title."},{"number":374,"text":" * @returns the updated Workspace projection."},{"number":375,"text":" */"},{"number":376,"text":"@Remote('rename') rename(request: WorkspaceRenameRequest): Promise"},{"number":377,"text":""},{"number":378,"text":"/**"},{"number":379,"text":" * Remove one Workspace registration while retaining files and Sessions."},{"number":380,"text":" * @param request - Workspace identity to remove."},{"number":381,"text":" * @returns deletion confirmation."},{"number":382,"text":" */"},{"number":383,"text":"@Remote('delete') delete(request: WorkspaceDeleteRequest): Promise"},{"number":384,"text":""},{"number":385,"text":"/**"},{"number":386,"text":" * Move one Workspace within the registry display order."},{"number":387,"text":" * @param request - moved Workspace and optional anchor."},{"number":388,"text":" * @returns the complete resulting Workspace order."},{"number":389,"text":" */"},{"number":390,"text":"@Remote('insertBefore') insertBefore(request: WorkspaceInsertBeforeRequest): Promise"},{"number":391,"text":""},{"number":392,"text":"/**"},{"number":393,"text":" * Move one accounted Session within a Workspace."},{"number":394,"text":" * @param request - Workspace, Session, and optional anchor identities."},{"number":395,"text":" * @returns the updated Workspace projection."},{"number":396,"text":" */"},{"number":397,"text":"@Remote('insertSessionBefore') insertSessionBefore(request: WorkspaceInsertSessionBeforeRequest): Promise"},{"number":398,"text":""},{"number":399,"text":"/**"},{"number":400,"text":" * Hide one known Session from Workspace grouping surfaces."},{"number":401,"text":" * @param request - Session identity to archive."},{"number":402,"text":" * @returns the complete resulting archive set."},{"number":403,"text":" */"},{"number":404,"text":"@Remote('archiveSession') archiveSession(request: WorkspaceArchiveSessionRequest): Promise"},{"number":405,"text":""},{"number":406,"text":"/**"},{"number":407,"text":" * Restore one archived Session to Workspace grouping surfaces."},{"number":408,"text":" * @param request - Session identity to unarchive."},{"number":409,"text":" * @returns the complete resulting archive set."},{"number":410,"text":" */"},{"number":411,"text":"@Remote('unarchiveSession') unarchiveSession(request: WorkspaceUnarchiveSessionRequest): Promise"},{"number":412,"text":""},{"number":413,"text":"/**"},{"number":414,"text":" * Surface one known unarchived Session ahead of unpinned Sessions."},{"number":415,"text":" * @param request - Session identity to pin."},{"number":416,"text":" * @returns the complete resulting pin set, most recently pinned first."},{"number":417,"text":" */"},{"number":418,"text":"@Remote('pinSession') pinSession(request: WorkspacePinSessionRequest): Promise"},{"number":419,"text":""},{"number":420,"text":"/**"},{"number":421,"text":" * Remove one Session's pin without changing its saved Session order."},{"number":422,"text":" * @param request - Session identity to unpin."},{"number":423,"text":" * @returns the complete resulting pin set, most recently pinned first."},{"number":424,"text":" */"},{"number":425,"text":"@Remote('unpinSession') unpinSession(request: WorkspaceUnpinSessionRequest): Promise"},{"number":426,"text":""},{"number":427,"text":"/**"},{"number":428,"text":" * Stream a complete Workspace baseline followed by ordered increments. A"},{"number":429,"text":" * non-owner receives only the Workspaces and Sessions `allows()` admits."},{"number":430,"text":" * When a delivered Workspace is no longer admitted at its next change or"},{"number":431,"text":" * the next order change, the stream sends a `replace` frame with the"},{"number":432,"text":" * complete filtered state instead of a `remove`, because a Client never"},{"number":433,"text":" * resurrects a removed Workspace; a `remove` frame reports a deletion and"},{"number":434,"text":" * reaches only a Client that received that Workspace."},{"number":435,"text":" * @param signal - generation cancellation."},{"number":436,"text":" * @returns baseline followed by ordered Workspace increments."},{"number":437,"text":" */"},{"number":438,"text":"@Remote({ mode: 'stream' }) async *follow(signal: AbortSignal): AsyncIterable"},{"number":439,"text":"```"},{"number":440,"text":""},{"number":441,"text":"Source: [`packages/api/workspace-controller/src/index.ts`](../../packages/api/workspace-controller/src/index.ts)"},{"number":442,"text":""},{"number":443,"text":""},{"number":444,"text":""},{"number":445,"text":"### `ctx.workspaceFiles` — `WorkspaceFiles`"},{"number":446,"text":""},{"number":447,"text":"Host Remote file reads and workspace directory observations over the composed filesystem."},{"number":448,"text":""},{"number":449,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":450,"text":"/**"},{"number":451,"text":" * Read one page of lines from a UTF-8 file readable by the filesystem backend."},{"number":452,"text":" * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire."},{"number":453,"text":" * @param path - absolute path or path relative to the workspace root; files outside it are allowed."},{"number":454,"text":" * @param range - the line window; omitted fields take the page defaults."},{"number":455,"text":" * @param signal - caller cancellation."},{"number":456,"text":" * @returns the page, the file's version at the stat before it, and whether it reaches the last line."},{"number":457,"text":" */"},{"number":458,"text":"@Remote async read( workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, range: WorkspaceFileRange, signal: AbortSignal, ): Promise"},{"number":459,"text":""},{"number":460,"text":"/**"},{"number":461,"text":" * Read a complete regular file or one byte range without text decoding."},{"number":462,"text":" * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire."},{"number":463,"text":" * @param path - target path, absolute or workspace-relative; relative to the base file's directory when provided."},{"number":464,"text":" * @param options - optional base file and range; without a range the complete-file cap applies."},{"number":465,"text":" * @param signal - caller cancellation."},{"number":466,"text":" * @returns native bytes with the file's version and size at the preceding stat, byte offset, and EOF marker."},{"number":467,"text":" */"},{"number":468,"text":"@Remote async readBytes( workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, options: WorkspaceByteReadOptions, signal: AbortSignal, ): Promise"},{"number":469,"text":""},{"number":470,"text":"/**"},{"number":471,"text":" * Report one regular file's identity, version, and size without its content."},{"number":472,"text":" * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire."},{"number":473,"text":" * @param path - absolute path or path relative to the workspace root; files outside it are allowed."},{"number":474,"text":" * @param signal - caller cancellation."},{"number":475,"text":" * @returns the file's absolute path, current version, and byte size."},{"number":476,"text":" */"},{"number":477,"text":"@Remote async stat(workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":478,"text":""},{"number":479,"text":"/**"},{"number":480,"text":" * List the direct children of one directory inside the Session's workspace."},{"number":481,"text":" * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire."},{"number":482,"text":" * @param path - workspace path, absolute or relative to the workspace root."},{"number":483,"text":" * @param signal - caller cancellation."},{"number":484,"text":" * @returns the directory's children in the backend's stable name order, bounded by the entry cap."},{"number":485,"text":" */"},{"number":486,"text":"@Remote async list(workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise"},{"number":487,"text":""},{"number":488,"text":"/**"},{"number":489,"text":" * Search files and their inferred ancestor directories with packaged ripgrep."},{"number":490,"text":" * Native ignore rules apply unless disabled; VCS metadata, symlinks and empty"},{"number":491,"text":" * directories are absent. Within the bounded set of listed files, matches"},{"number":492,"text":" * sort by depth, then workspace-relative path."},{"number":493,"text":" * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire."},{"number":494,"text":" * @param request - the query, literal exclusions, and hidden/ignore switches."},{"number":495,"text":" * @param signal - caller cancellation, forwarded to the subprocess; rejection preserves its reason."},{"number":496,"text":" * @returns matches capped by search.maxResults; incomplete marks excess rg files or exit 2."},{"number":497,"text":" * @throws RemoteError `gateway/bad-request`: the query is blank."},{"number":498,"text":" * @throws RemoteError `workspace-file/not-found`: the workspace root does not exist."},{"number":499,"text":" * @throws RemoteError `workspace-file/not-directory`: the workspace root is not a directory."},{"number":500,"text":" * @throws RemoteError `workspace-file/search-failed`: subprocess is missing, rg cannot launch or execute, or the search times out."},{"number":501,"text":" */"},{"number":502,"text":"@Remote async search( workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, request: WorkspaceFileSearchRequest, signal: AbortSignal, ): Promise"},{"number":503,"text":""},{"number":504,"text":"/**"},{"number":505,"text":" * Watch one file or a directory's direct entries in the Session's filesystem."},{"number":506,"text":" * Files use the backend's read authority; directories remain workspace-scoped."},{"number":507,"text":" * @param workspaceFileScope - header-derived workspace root for the Session identity on the wire."},{"number":508,"text":" * @param path - target path; the Host determines its type and confines directories to the workspace."},{"number":509,"text":" * @param signal - generation cancellation."},{"number":510,"text":" * @returns `ready` once the target watch is active, then current metadata for queued and live invalidations."},{"number":511,"text":" * @throws RemoteError when watching is unavailable or a directory is outside the workspace."},{"number":512,"text":" */"},{"number":513,"text":"@Remote({ mode: 'stream' }) changes(workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope, path: string, signal: AbortSignal): AsyncIterable"},{"number":514,"text":"```"},{"number":515,"text":""},{"number":516,"text":"Source: [`packages/api/workspace-files/src/index.ts`](../../packages/api/workspace-files/src/index.ts)"},{"number":517,"text":""},{"number":518,"text":""},{"number":519,"text":""},{"number":520,"text":"### `ctx.workspaceRegistry` — `WorkspaceRegistry`"},{"number":521,"text":""},{"number":522,"text":"Durable workspace registry. Startup waits for `sessionPersistence`, builds one canonical-cwd header index, and completes the one-time history bootstrap before the service becomes active. The persistence dependency is mandatory so an unavailable peer can never be mistaken for an empty history and commit the initialized marker."},{"number":523,"text":""},{"number":524,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":525,"text":"/**"},{"number":526,"text":" * Create or reuse a workspace for an existing directory. The fully qualified"},{"number":527,"text":" * path is canonicalized through `fs.realpath`; a relative, nonexistent, or"},{"number":528,"text":" * non-directory path rejects. Repeated calls for the same canonical path"},{"number":529,"text":" * return the existing entity without changing its title."},{"number":530,"text":" * A newly created workspace is prepended to the durable registry order."},{"number":531,"text":" * Different canonical paths may share a display title."},{"number":532,"text":" * @param path - Existing directory to own, in a fully qualified path spelling."},{"number":533,"text":" * @param title - Display title used only when a new record is created."},{"number":534,"text":" * @returns the existing or newly durable workspace."},{"number":535,"text":" */"},{"number":536,"text":"async create(path: string, title?: string): Promise"},{"number":537,"text":""},{"number":538,"text":"/**"},{"number":539,"text":" * Initialize the default Workspace only while both the registry and Session"},{"number":540,"text":" * history are empty. Repeated requests reuse its durable identity; deleting"},{"number":541,"text":" * that registration permanently disables automatic creation."},{"number":542,"text":" * @param resolveDirectory - resolve the absolute directory; called only for"},{"number":543,"text":" * eligible creation, inside the registry mutation queue. Missing directories"},{"number":544,"text":" * are created recursively before registration, and the initial title is the"},{"number":545,"text":" * requested directory's own final segment — not the canonical one, so a"},{"number":546,"text":" * symlink at that path does not retitle the Workspace after its target."},{"number":547,"text":" * After resolution, caller cancellation does not roll back creation or registration."},{"number":548,"text":" * @returns the initialized Workspace, or undefined when automatic creation is ineligible."},{"number":549,"text":" */"},{"number":550,"text":"initializeDefault(resolveDirectory: () => Promise): Promise"},{"number":551,"text":""},{"number":552,"text":"/**"},{"number":553,"text":" * Look up a workspace by id."},{"number":554,"text":" * @param id - Workspace id."},{"number":555,"text":" * @returns the workspace, or `undefined` when unknown."},{"number":556,"text":" */"},{"number":557,"text":"get(id: WorkspaceId): Workspace | undefined"},{"number":558,"text":""},{"number":559,"text":"/**"},{"number":560,"text":" * Synchronous workspace projection in durable registry order. Every"},{"number":561,"text":" * entity's `sessionIds` getter is already filtered by the startup/live"},{"number":562,"text":" * canonical-cwd header index; this method performs no persistence reads."},{"number":563,"text":" * @returns a fresh ordered array of workspace entities."},{"number":564,"text":" */"},{"number":565,"text":"list(): Workspace[]"},{"number":566,"text":""},{"number":567,"text":"/**"},{"number":568,"text":" * Delete one workspace registration while retaining its directory and every"},{"number":569,"text":" * session log. The durable order is updated before the table deletion; a"},{"number":570,"text":" * failed table write restores the prior order and keeps the entity"},{"number":571,"text":" * published. Unknown ids are an idempotent no-op for domain callers."},{"number":572,"text":" * @param id - Workspace registration to remove."},{"number":573,"text":" * @returns `true` when a record was deleted, `false` when it was unknown."},{"number":574,"text":" */"},{"number":575,"text":"delete(id: WorkspaceId): Promise"},{"number":576,"text":""},{"number":577,"text":"/**"},{"number":578,"text":" * Move one workspace within the durable display order, DOM-insertBefore-like."},{"number":579,"text":" * With an anchor it lands before that workspace; without one it appends."},{"number":580,"text":" * @param id - Workspace to move."},{"number":581,"text":" * @param beforeId - Workspace anchor; omitted appends."},{"number":582,"text":" * @returns the complete committed workspace order."},{"number":583,"text":" */"},{"number":584,"text":"insertBefore(id: WorkspaceId, beforeId?: WorkspaceId): Promise"},{"number":585,"text":""},{"number":586,"text":"/**"},{"number":587,"text":" * Archive one session durably. The session must exist (live or in session"},{"number":588,"text":" * persistence); its workspace accounting — or lack of one — is irrelevant."},{"number":589,"text":" * Without `stopActivity` the session must also be inactive: the"},{"number":590,"text":" * `workspace/session-activity` waterfall is asked once, and any reported"},{"number":591,"text":" * activity rejects with {@link WorkspaceActiveSessionError} before anything"},{"number":592,"text":" * is written. With `stopActivity` the archive is written without an"},{"number":593,"text":" * activity check, and the `workspace/session-stop` providers are then asked"},{"number":594,"text":" * to stop the session's work: the durable archive set is what a provider's"},{"number":595,"text":" * `agent/pre-step` gate reads, so every wake the stops induce is already"},{"number":596,"text":" * blocked. Archiving drops the session's pin in the same durable write"},{"number":597,"text":" * (pinning and archival are mutually exclusive). An already archived id"},{"number":598,"text":" * resolves without writing, asking, or stopping."},{"number":599,"text":" * @param sessionId - The session to archive."},{"number":600,"text":" * @param options - Whether running work is stopped instead of refusing."},{"number":601,"text":" * @returns resolution after durability, any stop requests, and follow-up admission."},{"number":602,"text":" */"},{"number":603,"text":"archiveSession(sessionId: SessionId, options: ArchiveSessionOptions = {}): Promise"},{"number":604,"text":""},{"number":605,"text":"/**"},{"number":606,"text":" * Unarchive one session durably by dropping it from the registry-global"},{"number":607,"text":" * archive set; the accounting slot was never touched, so the session"},{"number":608,"text":" * returns to its recorded position. Unarchiving runs no session-existence"},{"number":609,"text":" * check because removing an id cannot introduce an unknown one, so an"},{"number":610,"text":" * entry whose session is gone still resolves. An id that is not archived"},{"number":611,"text":" * resolves without writing."},{"number":612,"text":" * @param sessionId - The session to unarchive."},{"number":613,"text":" * @returns resolution after durability."},{"number":614,"text":" */"},{"number":615,"text":"unarchiveSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise"},{"number":616,"text":""},{"number":617,"text":"/**"},{"number":618,"text":" * Pin one session durably, prepending it to the registry-global pin set."},{"number":619,"text":" * The session must exist (live or in session persistence) and must not be"},{"number":620,"text":" * archived. An already pinned id resolves without writing or reordering."},{"number":621,"text":" * @param sessionId - The session to pin."},{"number":622,"text":" * @returns resolution after durability."},{"number":623,"text":" */"},{"number":624,"text":"pinSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise"},{"number":625,"text":""},{"number":626,"text":"/**"},{"number":627,"text":" * Unpin one session durably by dropping it from the registry-global pin"},{"number":628,"text":" * set. Unpinning runs no session-existence check because removing an id"},{"number":629,"text":" * cannot introduce an unknown one, so an entry whose session is gone still"},{"number":630,"text":" * resolves. An id that is not pinned resolves without writing."},{"number":631,"text":" * @param sessionId - The session to unpin."},{"number":632,"text":" * @returns resolution after durability."},{"number":633,"text":" */"},{"number":634,"text":"unpinSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise"},{"number":635,"text":""},{"number":636,"text":"/**"},{"number":637,"text":" * Resolve by canonical directory path without creating or mutating a"},{"number":638,"text":" * workspace. A missing path rejects during `realpath`; an existing unowned"},{"number":639,"text":" * directory returns `undefined`."},{"number":640,"text":" * @param path - Existing directory path in a fully qualified spelling."},{"number":641,"text":" * @returns the workspace owning the canonical path, when one exists."},{"number":642,"text":" */"},{"number":643,"text":"async resolveByPath(path: string): Promise"},{"number":644,"text":"```"},{"number":645,"text":""},{"number":646,"text":"Types: [SessionId](core.zh.md)"},{"number":647,"text":""},{"number":648,"text":"Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)"},{"number":649,"text":""},{"number":650,"text":""},{"number":651,"text":""},{"number":652,"text":"### `workspace/*` events"},{"number":653,"text":""},{"number":654,"text":""},{"number":655,"text":""},{"number":656,"text":"#### `workspace/session-activity` — waterfall"},{"number":657,"text":""},{"number":658,"text":"Ask the composed providers what still runs for a session before it is archived. A listener prepends its own SessionActivity entries to the result of `next()`; the registry's innermost callback returns an empty list, so a composition without providers archives freely. Any non-empty result refuses the archive without a write."},{"number":659,"text":""},{"number":660,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":661,"text":"/**"},{"number":662,"text":" * Ask the composed providers what still runs for a session before it is"},{"number":663,"text":" * archived. A listener prepends its own {@link SessionActivity} entries to"},{"number":664,"text":" * the result of `next()`; the registry's innermost callback returns an"},{"number":665,"text":" * empty list, so a composition without providers archives freely. Any"},{"number":666,"text":" * non-empty result refuses the archive without a write."},{"number":667,"text":" * @param request - the session about to be archived."},{"number":668,"text":" * @param next - delegate to the remaining providers."},{"number":669,"text":" * @mode waterfall"},{"number":670,"text":" */"},{"number":671,"text":"'workspace/session-activity'( request: SessionActivityRequest, next: () => Promise, ): Promise"},{"number":672,"text":"```"},{"number":673,"text":""},{"number":674,"text":"Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)"},{"number":675,"text":""},{"number":676,"text":""},{"number":677,"text":""},{"number":678,"text":"#### `workspace/session-archived` — parallel"},{"number":679,"text":""},{"number":680,"text":"Admit optional follow-up work after durable archival and any stop requests. Dispatched inside the registry's write queue: a listener registers its work and returns, and runs the work and any unbounded I/O afterwards. Listener failures are logged without undoing archival. Listeners own and drain their background work."},{"number":681,"text":""},{"number":682,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":683,"text":"/**"},{"number":684,"text":" * Admit optional follow-up work after durable archival and any stop requests."},{"number":685,"text":" * Dispatched inside the registry's write queue: a listener registers its work"},{"number":686,"text":" * and returns, and runs the work and any unbounded I/O afterwards. Listener"},{"number":687,"text":" * failures are logged without undoing archival. Listeners own and drain their background work."},{"number":688,"text":" * @param request - newly archived Session; repeated archive requests do not dispatch."},{"number":689,"text":" * @mode parallel"},{"number":690,"text":" */"},{"number":691,"text":"'workspace/session-archived'(request: SessionActivityRequest): Promise | void"},{"number":692,"text":"```"},{"number":693,"text":""},{"number":694,"text":"Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)"},{"number":695,"text":""},{"number":696,"text":""},{"number":697,"text":""},{"number":698,"text":"#### `workspace/session-stop` — parallel"},{"number":699,"text":""},{"number":700,"text":"Stop a session's running work because the caller archived it with `stopActivity`; the archive set is durable when this dispatches. Each provider stops its own families — cancelling a turn, its subagent descendants, owned jobs, or active schedules — through the same cancel paths the user's own stop actions use, so the session log ends every open turn regularly and a later unarchive can continue the conversation. Listeners issue their stop requests without waiting for running work to settle; a listener may await its own durability barrier. A rejection is logged by the registry and does not undo the archive."},{"number":701,"text":""},{"number":702,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":703,"text":"/**"},{"number":704,"text":" * Stop a session's running work because the caller archived it with"},{"number":705,"text":" * `stopActivity`; the archive set is durable when this dispatches. Each"},{"number":706,"text":" * provider stops its own families — cancelling a turn, its subagent"},{"number":707,"text":" * descendants, owned jobs, or active schedules — through the same cancel"},{"number":708,"text":" * paths the user's own stop actions use, so the session log ends every"},{"number":709,"text":" * open turn regularly and a later unarchive can continue the"},{"number":710,"text":" * conversation. Listeners issue their stop requests without waiting for"},{"number":711,"text":" * running work to settle; a listener may await its own durability"},{"number":712,"text":" * barrier. A rejection is logged by the registry and does not undo the"},{"number":713,"text":" * archive."},{"number":714,"text":" * @param request - the session being archived."},{"number":715,"text":" * @mode parallel"},{"number":716,"text":" */"},{"number":717,"text":"'workspace/session-stop'(request: SessionActivityRequest): Promise | void"},{"number":718,"text":"```"},{"number":719,"text":""},{"number":720,"text":"Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)"},{"number":721,"text":""},{"number":722,"text":""},{"number":723,"text":""},{"number":724,"text":"#### `workspace/session-unarchiving` — parallel"},{"number":725,"text":""},{"number":726,"text":"Cancel or settle archive follow-up work before making a Session available again. A rejection retains the archived state."},{"number":727,"text":""},{"number":728,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":729,"text":"/**"},{"number":730,"text":" * Cancel or settle archive follow-up work before making a Session available again."},{"number":731,"text":" * A rejection retains the archived state."},{"number":732,"text":" * @param request - Session about to leave the archive set."},{"number":733,"text":" * @mode parallel"},{"number":734,"text":" */"},{"number":735,"text":"'workspace/session-unarchiving'(request: SessionActivityRequest): Promise | void"},{"number":736,"text":"```"},{"number":737,"text":""},{"number":738,"text":"Source: [`packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts`](../../packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)"},{"number":739,"text":""}],"totalLines":739,"lang":"md"}},"sourceEventSeqs":[236],"surfaceOp":"append"} {"type":"step/end","seq":239,"time":1795439814973,"data":{"turn":6,"step":20}} {"type":"step/start","seq":240,"time":1795439815004,"data":{"turn":6,"step":21}} {"type":"session-log-deepseek/delivery-accepted","seq":241,"time":1795439820576,"data":{"sessionId":"session-2dbd4a21-acde-4799-a730-963feb5229b6","sessionFormatVersion":4,"throughSeq":240}} {"type":"assistant/message","seq":242,"time":1795439825026,"data":{"turn":6,"step":21,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"reasoning","text":"Now the key: sandbox mode default comes from deployment config (`ctx.sandboxPolicy` deployment default mode). name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy'\n config:\n mode: !!js process.env.DSH_PERMISSION_MODE ?? 'workspace-write'\n workspaceRoot: !!js process.cwd()\n```\n\nand approval plugin:\n```yaml\n- id: ... approval? \n policy: !!js \"(process.env.DSH_PERMISSION_MODE ?? 'workspace-write') === 'danger-full-access' ? 'never' : 'ask'\"\n```\n\nSo in Desktop the default sandbox mode is workspace-write with workspaceRoot = process.cwd() — i.e., the Desktop app's cwd. Note: for the QQ bot sessions, the workspace boundary is the session's cwd (the agent's cwd), per sandbox doc: \"普通工具调用从调用会话的不可变 cwd 派生 workspaceRoot\". So a qqbot session with cwd=~/.dsh-qqbot/workspace can only write there.\n\nTo give full access, two options:\n1. Override `sandbox-policy` config `mode: danger-full-access` in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. But that's global for the whole Desktop profile (also affects the GUI sessions). In this session the file policy is already danger-full-access... interesting — the user changed approval policy to never ask and file policy to danger-full-access. That's session-level (via /mode command or approval UI).\n2. Set qqbot `cwd` to a broad directory (e.g. C:\\ or C:\\Users\\xueha) — workspace-write then permits writes there (whole subtree).\n3. Use `additionalWritableRoots`? On Windows, process confinement ignores extra roots; only harness fs tools honor them. Not good.\n\nAlso note: `sendFile.restrictPaths` and `extraRoots` control the qqbot's file-sending whitelist — separate from the sandbox.\n\nNow — does the qqbot plugin's `cwd` config actually get used when creating sessions? Yes: `resolveAgentCwd(config.cwd)` passed as meta.cwd.\n\nBut careful: the qqbot plugin's per-session sandbox mode. When qqbot creates the session, the session's sandbox mode defaults to deployment default (workspace-write) unless a `sandbox/mode` event exists in the session log. So changing deployment default to danger-full-access will apply to new qqbot sessions (and GUI sessions too).\n\nIs there a per-session mode? The sandbox doc says `overrideOf(session)` reads last logged `sandbox/mode` event; GUI has a mode switcher. For qqbot sessions, the plugin doesn't log sandbox/mode. But maybe the user can change it via the GUI since qqbot sessions show up in the Desktop GUI sessions list. Hmm, that's a neat trick: change model/mode in GUI? The mode switcher might log `sandbox/mode`. Actually, the qqbot also supports slash commands? Let me check whether qqbot has a command to set permission mode... Let me grep the qqbot lib for 'mode' commands, e.g. \"/mode\".\n\nAlso: does the agent preset matter? Presets can carry capabilities. The qqbot `preset` config could point to a custom preset that... but presets don't set sandbox mode I think.\n\nLet's check qqbot commands {"type":"tool/result","seq":293,"time":1795439875796,"data":{"turn":6,"step":27,"message":{"role":"tool","source":{"kind":"tool","callId":"call_00_A4UrQyUDNLJjY52DrgQh8233"},"toolCallId":"call_00_A4UrQyUDNLJjY52DrgQh8233","content":[{"type":"text","text":"C:\\Users\\xueha\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\DeepSeek Harness\\resources\\app.asar\\dsh\\node_modules\\@deepseek-ai\\dsh\\docs\\subsystems\\permission-presets.zh.md\nfile\n\n1: # 权限预设\n2: \n3: [English](permission-presets.md) | 中文\n4: \n5: [dsh-permission-presets](../../packages/interaction/permission-presets) 的权限预设层（`ctx.permissionPresets`，`PermissionPresetService`）把两个相互独立的强制执行 knob，即[沙箱模式](sandbox.zh.md)（`sandbox/mode`）与[审批策略](approval.zh.md)（`approval/policy`），捆绑成具名预设，供客户端作为单个 Permissions 选择器提供。配置表拥有未来会话默认值，而固定的 `registerAuto(admit)` 钩子让 [Auto review](../../packages/experimental/auto-review/README.zh.md) integration 在一个 effect 生命周期内发布仅限当前会话的选项。该层是可选能力，且不拥有执行策略：提示词叙述与回放仍读取各自 knob 的折叠结果，额外强制执行由 Auto review 拥有。[包 README](../../packages/interaction/permission-presets/README.zh.md)负责组合状态与限制；[历史沙箱切换设计](../../.agents/notes/archived/feature/2026-07-06-sandbox.md)负责原始旋钮依据。\n6: \n7: 源码：[`packages/interaction/permission-presets/src/index.ts`](../../packages/interaction/permission-presets/src/index.ts)\n8: \n9: ## 预设表\n10: \n11: 预设把一个稳定 key 映射到一组沙箱／审批组合，外加可选的客户端展示信息。默认配置表自带 `workspace-write`（`workspace-write` + `ask`）和 `danger-full-access`（`danger-full-access` + `never`）；`custom` 与 `auto` 是保留名称，不能配置。\n12: \n13: ```ts type-equiv\n14: /** One preset's sandbox/approval bundle and optional client presentation. */\n15: interface PresetSpec {\n16: /** The `sandbox/mode` value the preset writes through. */\n17: sandbox: SandboxMode\n18: /** The `approval/policy` value the preset writes through. */\n19: approval: ApprovalPolicy\n20: /** The display label a client shows for this preset; the raw table key when omitted. */\n21: name?: string\n22: /** One user-facing sentence on what the preset means; omitted when not configured. */\n23: description?: string\n24: }\n25: ```\n26: \n27: ```ts type-equiv\n28: /** The {@link PermissionPresetService} config: preset table and composition default. */\n29: interface Config {\n30: /**\n31: * The preset table: name → knob bundle. Defaults to `workspace-write`\n32: * (workspace-write + ask) and `danger-full-access` (danger-full-access +\n33: * never). The names `custom` and `auto` are reserved for derived state and\n34: * the Auto review integration respectively.\n35: */\n36: presets: Record\n37: /**\n38: * Default for new sessions. When omitted, the preset matching the composed\n39: * sandbox and approval defaults is used.\n40: */\n41: defaultPreset: Volatile\n42: }\n43: ```\n44: \n45: 该服务要求一个施加隔离的 `ctx.shell` 执行器和 `ctx.approval`，配置错误在插件加载时即失败：名为 `custom` 或 `auto` 的配置条目会抛出异常；在不施加隔离的 bash 执行器（没有 `sandboxMode` 能力事实）之上组合同样抛出异常，因为预设捆绑了一个沙箱模式。\n46: \n47: ## 固定的当前会话 Auto 注册\n48: \n49: Auto integration 会在自身 effect 生命周期内调用 `registerAuto(admit)`。本服务固定 `auto` 身份以及 `danger-full-access` 加 `ask` 的组合，已记录的 Auto 选择也匹配委派子会话固定的 `never` 策略；shipped 客户端的 locale 字典拥有 Auto 的 label 与 description，而配置预设的展示信息仍归 Host 所有。调用方不能通过通用 contribution API 发布其他预设。Auto 排列在配置预设之后，绝不会进入 `permission.defaultPreset` 设置 schema，并在 effect dispose 时消失。同步 `admit` 回调会在 Auto 选择修改 Session 前，以及存储的 Auto Session 发布前运行，因此 integration 缺失或正在关闭时不会改写持久身份。\n50: \n51: 注册或移除 Auto 会发出无 payload 的 `permission-presets/catalog-changed` 通知。进程级消费方先订阅，再调用 `catalog()`；每次收到通知后重新读取完整的可选目录。`permissions` Session 投影只包含 `currentValue`，因此目录变化不会追加 Session 事件、发布 Session 投影帧或改变 Session 序列。\n52: \n53: ## 当前预设与派生的 `custom`\n54: \n55: `current(session)` 从必需的 `permissions` 投影派生实际生效的预设。该单元折叠会话的沙箱模式、审批策略和已记录选择；状态内部的缺失值回退到执行器配置的模式与审批服务配置，最后回退到 `ask`。投影 key 缺失时会显式失败。服务优先取仍然匹配的选择（包括 `never` 审批策略下已记录的 Auto 选择），其次取第一个匹配的配置条目，否则返回 `CUSTOM_PRESET`（`'custom'`）。`custom` 只是派生值：客户端可以把它显示为当前值，但它绝不是切换目标，也绝不出现在事件 payload 中。\n56: \n57: `names` 先按声明顺序列出配置预设，再在 Auto integration 存活时列出 Auto。`catalog()` 把这些可选条目作为一份进程级快照返回。`optionOf(name)` 为可用条目（label 回退为该 key）或派生的 `custom` 展示构建选项，传入其他任何名称都会抛出异常。客户端把目录与 Session 投影合并；`custom` 可以标记当前值，但绝不会成为目录条目。\n58: \n59: ```ts type-equiv\n60: /** Presentation for an available preset or the derived `custom` current value. */\n61: interface PresetOption {\n62: /** Stable option value: a configured preset key, live `auto`, or derived `custom`. */\n63: value: string\n64: /** The display label. */\n65: name: string\n66: /** One user-facing sentence on what the value means; omitted when not configured. */\n67: description?: string\n68: }\n69: ```\n70: \n71: ## 切换与 `permission/preset` 事件\n72: \n73: `set(session, name)` 解析预设（未知名称抛出异常），在适用时运行 Auto 准入，在 `name` 尚不是生效预设时追加一条仅记日志的 `permission/preset` 事件，然后通过各旋钮自己的 setter（[dsh-sandbox-policy](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-policy) 的 `setSandboxMode` 与 [dsh-user-approval](../../packages/interaction/user-approval) 的 `setApprovalPolicy`）写入，且仅当该 knob 的生效值发生变化时才写。同一轮次内，选择事件先于旋钮事件出现；重新选择当前生效的预设则什么都不追加。\n74: \n75: `permission/preset` 是持久、仅记日志的用户意图：它不进入模型 transcript（文本记录），模型可见的后果由 knob 事件经各自消费方承担；它存在是为了在两个预设共享同一个旋钮组合时，让 `current()` 仍能保住用户选择的究竟是哪一个预设。`permissions` 投影把该选择与两个 knob 事件一同折叠，并保留用于区分空恢复 seed 与新会话的 `session/end-seed` 边界；回放不需要任何追赶状态或原始日志重扫。恢复的 `auto` 选择在 agent 发布前必须存在 live Auto 注册。完整事件声明见[持久化日志事件目录](../persistence-catalog.zh.md)；方法签名见生成的[服务目录](#ctxpermissionpresets--permissionpresetservice)。\n76: \n77: \n78: \n79: \n80: \n81: ## Cordis API\n82: \n83: Generated from source by `scripts/gen-cordis-catalog.ts` (verified fresh by `pnpm run verify-cordis-catalog` in doc-sync; regenerate with `pnpm run gen-cordis-catalog`) — the language sides differ only in locale-specific paired document paths. Signature blocks use a `ts cordis-catalog` fence and keep the original source JSDoc; dispatch modes are defined in the [primer](../cordis-primer.zh.md#dispatch-modes), and the framework-inherited `ctx` API lives in [cordis-api/inherited.md](../cordis-api/inherited.md).\n84: \n85: \n86: \n87: ### `ctx.permissionPresets` — `PermissionPresetService`\n88: \n89: Owns the deployment's configured permission presets, the fixed Auto integration hook, and their write path. Requires a confining `ctx.shell` executor and `ctx.approval`; unmatched knob values are reported as CUSTOM_PRESET, not an error.\n90: \n91: ```ts cordis-catalog\n92: /**\n93: * Read the complete process-level catalog exposed to current-session UI.\n94: * @returns every currently selectable preset in contribution order.\n95: */\n96: @Remote('catalog') catalog(): PermissionCatalog\n97: \n98: /**\n99: * Publish the fixed current-session Auto preset for the calling\n100: * integration's effect lifetime.\n101: * @param admit - synchronous gate run before live Auto selection or restore.\n102: * @returns the async effect disposer that removes Auto.\n103: */\n104: registerAuto(admit: () => void): () => Promise\n105: \n106: /**\n107: * Resolve the preset matching the effective knob values. A still-matching\n108: * last selection wins shared-bundle ties, and a still-selected Auto also\n109: * matches the `never` approval policy; otherwise the first configured\n110: * match wins. Returns\n111: * {@link CUSTOM_PRESET} when no available preset matches.\n112: * @param session - the session whose knob state is read.\n113: * @returns the effective preset name, or `custom` when nothing matches.\n114: */\n115: current(session: Session): string\n116: \n117: /**\n118: * Resolve an available preset's knob bundle.\n119: * @param name - the preset name to resolve.\n120: * @returns the configured bundle.\n\n(Showing lines 1-120 of 167. Use offset=121 to continue.)\n"}],"isError":false,"id":"afe64091-0ab4-4a34-ba08-33f7096f492d"},"meta":{"path":"C:\\Users\\xueha\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\DeepSeek integration 会在自身 effect 生命周期内调用 `registerAuto(admit)`。本服务固定 `auto` 身份以及 `danger-full-access` 加 `ask` 的组合，已记录的 Auto 选择也匹配委派子会话固定的 `never` 策略；shipped 客户端的 locale 字典拥有 Auto 的 label 与 description，而配置预设的展示信息仍归 Host 所有。调用方不能通过通用 contribution API 发布其他预设。Auto 排列在配置预设之后，绝不会进入 `permission.defaultPreset` 设置 schema，并在 effect dispose 时消失。同步 `admit` 回调会在 Auto 选择修改 Session 前，以及存储的 Auto Session 发布前运行，因此 integration 缺失或正在关闭时不会改写持久身份。"},{"number":50,"text":""},{"number":51,"text":"注册或移除 Auto 会发出无 payload 的 `permission-presets/catalog-changed` 通知。进程级消费方先订阅，再调用 `catalog()`；每次收到通知后重新读取完整的可选目录。`permissions` Session 投影只包含 `currentValue`，因此目录变化不会追加 Session 事件、发布 Session 投影帧或改变 Session 序列。"},{"number":52,"text":""},{"number":53,"text":"## 当前预设与派生的 `custom`"},{"number":54,"text":""},{"number":55,"text":"`current(session)` 从必需的 `permissions` 投影派生实际生效的预设。该单元折叠会话的沙箱模式、审批策略和已记录选择；状态内部的缺失值回退到执行器配置的模式与审批服务配置，最后回退到 `ask`。投影 key 缺失时会显式失败。服务优先取仍然匹配的选择（包括 `never` 审批策略下已记录的 Auto 选择），其次取第一个匹配的配置条目，否则返回 `CUSTOM_PRESET`（`'custom'`）。`custom` 只是派生值：客户端可以把它显示为当前值，但它绝不是切换目标，也绝不出现在事件 payload 中。"},{"number":56,"text":""},{"number":57,"text":"`names` 先按声明顺序列出配置预设，再在 Auto integration 存活时列出 Auto。`catalog()` 把这些可选条目作为一份进程级快照返回。`optionOf(name)` 为可用条目（label 回退为该 key）或派生的 `custom` 展示构建选项，传入其他任何名称都会抛出异常。客户端把目录与 Session 投影合并；`custom` 可以标记当前值，但绝不会成为目录条目。"},{"number":58,"text":""},{"number":59,"text":"```ts type-equiv"},{"number":60,"text":"/** Presentation for an available preset or the derived `custom` current value. */"},{"number":61,"text":"interface PresetOption {"},{"number":62,"text":" /** Stable option value: a configured preset key, live `auto`, or derived `custom`. */"},{"number":63,"text":" value: string"},{"number":64,"text":" /** The display label. */"},{"number":65,"text":" name: string"},{"number":66,"text":" /** One user-facing sentence on what the value means; omitted when not configured. */"},{"number":67,"text":" description?: string"},{"number":68,"text":"}"},{"number":69,"text":"```"},{"number":70,"text":""},{"number":71,"text":"## 切换与 `permission/preset` 事件"},{"number":72,"text":""},{"number":73,"text":"`set(session, name)` 解析预设（未知名称抛出异常），在适用时运行 Auto 准入，在 `name` 尚不是生效预设时追加一条仅记日志的 `permission/preset` 事件，然后通过各旋钮自己的 setter（[dsh-sandbox-policy](../../packages/sandbox/sandbox-policy) 的 `setSandboxMode` 与 [dsh-user-approval](../../packages/interaction/user-approval) 的 `setApprovalPolicy`）写入，且仅当该 knob 的生效值发生变化时才写。同一轮次内，选择事件先于旋钮事件出现；重新选择当前生效的预设则什么都不追加。"},{"number":74,"text":""},{"number":75,"text":"`permission/preset` 是持久、仅记日志的用户意图：它不进入模型 transcript（文本记录），模型可见的后果由 knob 事件经各自消费方承担；它存在是为了在两个预设共享同一个旋钮组合时，让 `current()` 仍能保住用户选择的究竟是哪一个预设。`permissions` 投影把该选择与两个 knob 事件一同折叠，并保留用于区分空恢复 seed 与新会话的 `session/end-seed` 边界；回放不需要任何追赶状态或原始日志重扫。恢复的 `auto` 选择在 agent 发布前必须存在 live Auto 注册。完整事件声明见[持久化日志事件目录](../persistence-catalog.zh.md)；方法签名见生成的[服务目录](#ctxpermissionpresets--permissionpresetservice)。"},{"number":76,"text":""},{"number":77,"text":""},{"number":78,"text":""},{"number":79,"text":""},{"number":80,"text":""},{"number":81,"text":"## Requires a confining `ctx.shell` executor and `ctx.approval`; unmatched knob values are reported as CUSTOM_PRESET, not an error."},{"number":90,"text":""},{"number":91,"text":"```ts cordis-catalog"},{"number":92,"text":"/**"},{"number":93,"text":" * Read the complete process-level catalog exposed to current-session UI."},{"number":94,"text":" * @returns every currently selectable preset in contribution order."},{"number":95,"text":" */"},{"number":96,"text":"@Remote('catalog') catalog(): PermissionCatalog"},{"number":97,"text":""},{"number":98,"text":"/**"},{"number":99,"text":" * Publish the fixed current-session Auto preset for the calling"},{"number":100,"text":" * integration's effect lifetime."},{"number":101,"text":" * @param admit - synchronous gate run before live Auto selection or restore."},{"number":102,"text":" * @returns the async effect disposer that removes Auto."},{"number":103,"text":" */"},{"number":104,"text":"registerAuto(admit: () => void): () => Promise"},{"number":105,"text":""},{"number":106,"text":"/**"},{"number":107,"text":" * Resolve the preset matching the effective knob values. But GUI shows a Permissions selector per session.\n\nFor qqbot, since sessions are created by the agent service with a permission/`sandbox/mode`... new sessions get default from persistent store? `permission.defaultPreset` is the default for new sessions. So setting `defaultPreset: danger-full-access` in profile cordis.patch.yml (id: permission) would give all NEW sessions (GUI and QQ) danger-full-access. Hmm, also affects GUI.\n\nBut wait — does the GUI's desktop app itself have a permission mode setting per session saved elsewhere? The session logs `permission/preset` events. For qqbot sessions, they persist in the session log; setting once via GUI would persist across restarts.\n\nAlternative cleaner approach for qqbot-only: Since qqbot's `cwd` is configurable, set cwd to `C:\\Users\\xueha` or `C:\\`. Then workspace-write boundary = that dir, giving broad write access without touching global policy. But the \"workspace-write\" mode still requires approval for... hmm, approval 'ask' with approval channel to QQ (the plugin has an approval channel that sends buttons to QQ). That works.\n\nBut the user says \"像dsh本体一样可以完全读取电脑的操作权限\" — full access. The cleanest: combine:\n1. `cwd: C:\\` (or set to a root) — actually if we set mode danger-full-access, cwd doesn't matter for access but still matters as the agent's working dir (and for qqbot's sendFile whitelist).\n2. Set the deployment default to danger-full-access OR set per-session.\n\nWhich is best? Let me check whether the Desktop GUI's permission selector writes to a stored preference that applies to all new sessions... `defaultPreset` is the \"Default for new sessions\" config — that's the intended knob. So editing `- id: permission` config with `defaultPreset: danger-full-access` gives every new session full access. But the user might not want the GUI sessions to lose safety. Hmm, the user's own GUI session already is danger-full-access (as stated in the system reminder), so they're fine.\n\nNow — is `permission` plugin's config the right id? In base patch: `- id: permission / name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets'`. To override just `defaultPreset` while keeping presets, patch config merges? Patch entries are \"id-targeted config overrides\" — likely deep-merged? If shallow, specifying only defaultPreset might drop presets and fall back to defaults (which are the same two presets). Defaults include workspace-write and danger-full-access, so it's fine either way.\n\nAlso there's `sandbox-policy` config `mode` (deployment default). Both exist; `defaultPreset` might be the cleaner intent. Actually the permission-presets README says \"配置表拥有未来会话默认值\" (the config table owns the default for future sessions) and `defaultPreset`: \"Default for new sessions.\" So use defaultPreset.\n\nHmm, but does `defaultPreset` write to sessions on creation, or only used by UI as initial selection? \"默认配置表自带 workspace-write ... 以及 danger-full-access\" and \"presets ... defaultPreset: Default for new sessions. When omitted, the preset matching the composed sandbox and approval defaults is used.\" I should check the source to be sure it applies on session creation (not just UI default). Let me grep the permission-presets source in asar for defaultPreset.\n\nLet me also verify how qqbot sessions get their `permissions` projection: it folds session's sandbox/mode + approval/policy events; absent → falls back to executor config mode and approval config.\n\nSo the *deterministic* way that affects qqbot sessions is `sandbox-policy.mode` (deployment default) because that's the fallback when the session has no logged mode. And `approval.policy` for approvals. `defaultPreset` only affects new sessions created through... let me check source.\n\nLet me grep source js of dsh-permission-presets for Harness\\resources\\app.asar\\dsh\\node_modules\\@deepseek-ai\\dsh-agent-instructions\\README.zh.md\nfile\n\n1: ---\n2: description: \"面向用户与维护者的工作区指令上下文说明，用于启用、设置预算或排查 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 的加载与刷新。\"\n3: kind: \"package-reference\"\n4: ---\n5: \n6: # @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions\n7: \n8: [English](README.md) | 中文\n9: \n10: ## 概述\n11: \n12: `dsh-agent-instructions` 向 agent（智能体）提供来自用户全局文件和项目级文件的工作区指引；这些文件均与 `AGENTS.md` 兼容。它为第一次请求加载适用的指令链。它不会持续监视外部编辑：成功的文件系统操作会发现新适用的嵌套文件，并让后续变更或移除可见；恢复会话也会对账基线。`dsh-base` 默认启用此行为，profile 可以禁用。字节预算分别限制用户全局指令链与项目指令链：每条链内较宽泛的文件先被省略，最具体的文件最后被截断，空指令链不添加任何内容。\n13: \n14: ## 目录\n15: \n16: - [使用本包](#use-this-package)\n17: - [理解实现](#understand-the-implementation)\n18: - [进一步探索](#further-exploration)\n19: - [模型体验](#model-experience)\n20: - [已知限制与延期工作](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work)\n21: - [开发备注](#dev-note)\n22: \n23: -----\n24: \n25: \n26: ## 使用本包\n27: \n28: 切换 Session 工作目录后，下一次请求前会重新加载适用的项目指令链。\n29: \n30: 当 agent 需要依据工作区自身的指令文件工作时，挂载此插件。`dsh-base` 已包含它，并为每条指令链给予 65,536 字节预算，因此基于 base 的 profile 仅在需要其他 `maxBytes` 时替换该配置行；没有文件系统提供方的树加载不到任何内容，直到提供方出现。\n31: \n32: ### agent 获得的内容\n33: \n34: 第一次请求包含一条持久基线消息：先是用户全局指令链——`$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，然后是 `/AGENTS.md`——再按从宽泛到具体的顺序包含项目指令链：从项目根目录到会话工作目录的每个目录中所有现有候选文件。同一候选组内去除首尾空白后内容一致的文件只渲染一次：复制了 `AGENTS.md` 的 `CLAUDE.md` 不会被重复加载，与 harness home 文件重复的共享根 `AGENTS.md` 也会折叠在其后。当成功的 `read`、`write` 或 `edit` 调用到达更深的目录后，下一次请求会包含新适用的指令文件；已改变的文件会替换其内容，消失或成为较早候选文件重复项的文件会产生移除通知。\n35: \n36: ### 配置\n37: \n38: 默认设置适合典型检出：`.git` 标记项目根目录，`AGENTS.md` 与 `CLAUDE.md` 是基础候选，`AGENTS.local.md` 与 `CLAUDE.local.md` 是叠加的本地 overlay。只有 `maxBytes` 必填——它在每条渲染消息内分别限制用户全局指令链与项目指令链，让每个部署显式选择自己的提示词预算；同时包含两条链的消息最多为 `maxBytes` 的两倍。\n39: \n40: 存放用户全局 `AGENTS.md` 的 harness home 属于进程策略，而不是配置行：该插件通过 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths` 解析 `$DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh`，因此指令加载始终读取进程 home。共享 agents 根目录同样如此解析：`$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` 或 `~/.agents`。残留的 `dshHome` 与 `agentsHome` 配置行字段会被忽略。\n41: \n42: 只有确认项目根标记不存在时，项目根发现才会继续上溯。权限或 I/O 失败会停止发现，并抛出宿主或文件系统提供方的原始错误，而不会选择祖先项目。[历史根标记元数据决策](../../../.agents/notes/archived/bug-fix/2026-09-03-root-marker-metadata-failures.md)说明发现为何必须失败，而不能替换为其他根目录。\n43: \n44: ```yaml\n45: - name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'\n46: config:\n47: maxBytes: 65536\n48: ```\n49: \n50: 受支持的字段一览：\n51: \n52: ```ts\n53: export interface Config {\n54: projectRootMarkers?: string[]\n55: maxBytes: number\n56: maxSourceBytes?: number\n57: instructionFileCandidates?: string[]\n58: localInstructionFileCandidates?: string[]\n59: }\n60: ```\n61: \n62: | 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |\n63: |---|---|---|\n64: | `maxBytes` | 必填 | 一条渲染消息中每条指令链（用户全局、项目）的上限，单位为字节；同时包含两条链的消息最多为该值的两倍 |\n65: | `maxSourceBytes` | `1048576` | 渲染前单个源指令文件的上限 |\n66: | `projectRootMarkers` | `['.git']` | 标记项目根目录的目录名 |\n67: | `instructionFileCandidates` | `['AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md']` | 每个项目目录中加载的基础文件名 |\n68: | `localInstructionFileCandidates` | `['AGENTS.local.md', 'CLAUDE.local.md']` | 在基础文件之后加载的本地 overlay 文件名 |\n69: \n70: 生成的[配置目录](../../../docs/config-catalog.zh.md#deepseek-aidsh-agent-instructions)是每个受支持字段及其 JSDoc 的穷尽式真源。\n71: \n72: ### 观察预算\n73: \n74: 渲染分别为用户全局指令链与项目指令链做预算，每条链各受 `maxBytes` 限制。在一条链内，渲染优先保留最具体的文件：先丢弃完整的较宽泛文件，再截断剩下的最后一个文件，然后依次退回到精简引言、带该文件空标题的预算通知，最后是仅含预算通知的文本。因此用户全局文件只有超出自身预算时才会被省略或截断，且 harness home 文件先于共享根目录文件被省略；下文的回退情形除外。可见的 `Workspace instruction budget ...` 通知会指名两条链中被省略与被截断的路径。超出预算的宽泛文件会被忽略；刷新期间它被视为暂时不可用，而非被移除。\n75: \n76: 所有文件合起来能放进 `maxBytes` 时，消息包含全部文件且没有预算通知；只有一条链有文件时，该链单独在 `maxBytes` 内渲染。其他情况下，一个 `` 框架包含合并后的预算通知（仅当有文件被省略或截断时）、一段引言（仅当某条链保留了框架时），以及按加载顺序排列的两条链渲染段落，因此基线中用户全局文件在前；这条消息可以超过 `maxBytes`，但至多为其两倍。若某条链在没有框架的情况下渲染，且合并后的框架会超过 `maxBytes` 的两倍，则所有文件改为作为一条链在一个 `maxBytes` 内渲染，这可能省略一个本可放进自身预算的用户全局文件；这只会在预算只有几百字节，或预算通知接近或超过 `maxBytes` 时发生。[按指令链分别预算的决策](../../../.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-10-16-separate-instruction-chain-budgets.zh.md)记录了两条链分别预算的原因。\n77: \n78: -----\n79: \n80: \n81: ## 理解实现\n82: \n83:
\n84: 实现细节——点击展开\n85: \n86: 本节解释插件背后的设计决策；可观察行为见[使用本包](#use-this-package)。\n87: \n88: ### 设计理念\n89: \n90: 该插件建立在一个原则上：工作区指令是持久的对话内容，按 agent 与会话分别归属。基线消息与刷新消息都是普通的带来源 `user/message` 事件，因此与其他历史一样可回放、可压缩（compaction）、可恢复，模型可见状态总能从会话日志重建。插件拥有完整的 `` 框架，每条注入消息都原样到达模型。\n91: \n92: ### 源码地图\n93: \n94: | 文件 | 职责 |\n95: |---|---|\n96: | [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts) | 插件入口：pre-step 监听器、`tools/result` touch 跟踪、inbox 组合 |\n97: | [`src/config.ts`](src/config.ts) | `Config` schema、预算解析、基线标识 |\n98: | [`src/files.ts`](src/files.ts) | 候选发现、项目根搜索、有界流式读取 |\n99: | [`src/render.ts`](src/render.ts) | 指令渲染、按指令链的预算截断、变更记录 |\n100: | [`src/state.ts`](src/state.ts) | 持久消息来源、版本／digest 缓存、对账 |\n101: | [`src/digest.ts`](src/digest.ts) | SHA-1 内容标识与每候选组重复键 |\n102: \n103: ### 主要流程\n104: \n105: 在会话第一次符合条件的 `agent/pre-step`，插件组合基线并把它折入进入步骤的批次、紧随已领取的消息之后。成功的第一方 `read`、`write`、`edit` 调用贡献的 touch 会沿父级执行 token 逐层上浮；当外层步骤进入持久历史后，一次投影会把可见会话状态与 inbox 对账，并排入新增、替换或移除。路径与 digest 都未变的内容绝不重复注入。发现跟随结构化文件系统活动，而非 shell 导航，因为每次本地 shell 调用都启动新进程，解析任意 shell 语法不是可靠的文件系统 seam。\n106: \n107: ### 不变式\n108: \n109: 每条注入消息都携带带类型的来源及其变更列表；完整基线还携带从规范化发现、优先级、项目根与预算配置派生的标识，匹配的持久消息会确认已排队的基线。模型可见文本不含隐藏状态标记，指令内容或模型可见元数据中的字面 `` 文本都会被转义，因此仓库控制的文本无法关闭插件控制的框架。\n110: \n111:
\n112: \n113: -----\n114: \n115: \n116: ## 进一步探索\n117: \n118: 包级约定不够用时阅读以下页面。它们从指令文件格式逐步进入设计决策与穷尽式配置。\n119: \n120: - [文档标准](../../../docs/AGENTS.md)——`AGENTS.md` 指令文件包含什么、如何维护。\n\n(Showing lines 1-120 of 239. @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions"},{"number":7,"text":""},{"number":8,"text":"[English](README.md) | 中文"},{"number":9,"text":""},{"number":10,"text":"## 概述"},{"number":11,"text":""},{"number":12,"text":"`dsh-agent-instructions` 向 agent（智能体）提供来自用户全局文件和项目级文件的工作区指引；这些文件均与 `AGENTS.md` 兼容。它为第一次请求加载适用的指令链。它不会持续监视外部编辑：成功的文件系统操作会发现新适用的嵌套文件，并让后续变更或移除可见；恢复会话也会对账基线。`dsh-base` 默认启用此行为，profile 可以禁用。字节预算分别限制用户全局指令链与项目指令链：每条链内较宽泛的文件先被省略，最具体的文件最后被截断，空指令链不添加任何内容。"},{"number":13,"text":""},{"number":14,"text":"## 目录"},{"number":15,"text":""},{"number":16,"text":"- [使用本包](#use-this-package)"},{"number":17,"text":"- [理解实现](#understand-the-implementation)"},{"number":18,"text":"- [进一步探索](#further-exploration)"},{"number":19,"text":"- Session 工作目录后，下一次请求前会重新加载适用的项目指令链。"},{"number":29,"text":""},{"number":30,"text":"当 agent 需要依据工作区自身的指令文件工作时，挂载此插件。`dsh-base` 已包含它，并为每条指令链给予 65,536 字节预算，因此基于 base 的 profile 仅在需要其他 `maxBytes` 时替换该配置行；没有文件系统提供方的树加载不到任何内容，直到提供方出现。"},{"number":31,"text":""},{"number":32,"text":"### agent 获得的内容"},{"number":33,"text":""},{"number":34,"text":"第一次请求包含一条持久基线消息：先是用户全局指令链——`$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，然后是 `/AGENTS.md`——再按从宽泛到具体的顺序包含项目指令链：从项目根目录到会话工作目录的每个目录中所有现有候选文件。同一候选组内去除首尾空白后内容一致的文件只渲染一次：复制了 `AGENTS.md` 的 `CLAUDE.md` 不会被重复加载，与 harness home 文件重复的共享根 `AGENTS.md` 也会折叠在其后。当成功的 `read`、`write` 或 `edit` 调用到达更深的目录后，下一次请求会包含新适用的指令文件；已改变的文件会替换其内容，消失或成为较早候选文件重复项的文件会产生移除通知。"},{"number":35,"text":""},{"number":36,"text":"### 配置"},{"number":37,"text":""},{"number":38,"text":"默认设置适合典型检出：`.git` 标记项目根目录，`AGENTS.md` 与 `CLAUDE.md` 是基础候选，`AGENTS.local.md` 与 `CLAUDE.local.md` 是叠加的本地 overlay。只有 `maxBytes` 必填——它在每条渲染消息内分别限制用户全局指令链与项目指令链，让每个部署显式选择自己的提示词预算；同时包含两条链的消息最多为 `maxBytes` 的两倍。"},{"number":39,"text":""},{"number":40,"text":"存放用户全局 `AGENTS.md` 的 harness home 属于进程策略，而不是配置行：该插件通过 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths` 解析 `$DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh`，因此指令加载始终读取进程 home。共享 agents 根目录同样如此解析：`$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` 或 `~/.agents`。残留的 `dshHome` 与 `agentsHome` 配置行字段会被忽略。"},{"number":41,"text":""},{"number":42,"text":"只有确认项目根标记不存在时，项目根发现才会继续上溯。权限或 I/O
